a: Davar sheeno nishshom mechayyim — la gezur rabbanan, uveyatme okmuha rabbanan addeorayyta.
Veaf rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak savar la leha derava, deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: minnayin lemasar behema shel yetomim shemmochrim oto kedarko?
Shenneemar: "rak bechol avvat nafshecha tizbach veachalta vasar", ezehu davar sheen bo beracha mechayyim ella leachar shechita? heve omer: ze masar behema.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehavelio baatzamot? rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi, chad amar: mavlio, vechad amar: en mavlio.
Vela peligi — ha bedakka, ha begassa.
Veibbaet ema: idde veidde begassa, vela peligi — mar ki atreh, umar ki atreh.
Gufa: bivchor hu omer: "lo yifde", venimkar; bemaaser neemar: "lo yiggael", veeno nimkar, lo chay velo shachut, velo tam velo baal mum. mena hane mille?
Amar rav chinnana amar rav, vechen amar rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: neemar "lo yiggael" bemaaser, veneemar "velo yiggael" bacharamim, ma lehallan mechira immo, af kan mechira immo.
Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mafne, dei la mafne, ikka lemifrach: ma lacharamim, shekken chalim al hakkol!
Laye afnoye mafne, lo yeamer "velo yiggael" bacharamim, veyigmar mimmaaser: ma maaser kadosh veeno nigal, af charamim kedoshim veenam nigalin. "velo yiggael" dichtav rachamana lema li? leafnoye.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lemaaser, shekken kadosh lefanav uleacharav!
Ella, lo yeamer "lo yiggael" bacharamim, veyigmar mibbechor: ma bechor kadosh veeno nigal, af charamim kedoshin veenan nigalin. "lo yiggael" dichtav rachamana lema li? leafnoye.
Ikka lemifrach: ma livchor, shekken kedushshato merechem!
Ella lo yeamer "lo yiggael" bemaaser, veyigmar haavara haavara mibbechor, ma bechor kadosh veeno nigal, af maaser kadosh veeno nigal. "lo yiggael" dichtav rachamana bemaaser lema li? leafnoye.
Veakkatti, bemaaser name la, mafne deikka lemifrach kidfarchinan!
"Vehaavarta" kera yattira hu.
Bechor name nelaf "geulla" "geulla" mecharamim! demaaser mafne, divchor la mafne.
Umay chazet delo tifde divchor — legufeh, udemaaser — leafnoye? veema: demaaser — legufeh, divchor — leafnoye!
Danin geulla miggeulla, veen danin pediyyay miggeulla.
May nafka minna? ha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen" — zo hi shiva zo hi bia!
Hane mille, hecha delekka dedame leh, aval ikka dedame leh — middedame leh yalfinan.
Velelaf bechor "haavara" "haavara" mimmaaser, deha maaser name gamar "geulla" "geulla" mecharamim!
Miet rachamana gabbe charamim, "hu" — "hu" velo bechor. veema "hu" velo maaser! maaser geulla kemoto.
Rava amar, "lo yiggael" dacharamim la tzerich, deitanhu hecha? i be vealim — hekdesh ninhu, i be chohen — chullin ninhu.

Detanya: charamim, kol zeman shehen bevet bealim — hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehem, shenneemar: "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai". netanan lechohen — hare hen kechullin lechol divrehem, shenneemar: "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye". "lo
b: Yiggael" dichtav rachamana lema li? im eno inyan lacharamim — tenehu inyan lemaaser. ema tenehu inyan livchor? maaser geulla kemoto.
Rav ashe amar: "lo yiggael" demaaser — lo yimmacher hu. amar rav ashe: mena amena la? dichtiv: "vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh lo yiggael".
Ematay ose temura — mechayyim, ematay eno nigal — mechayyim, ha leachar shechita — nigal, ha bae haamada vehaaracha!
Ella shema minna, "lo yiggael" — lo yimmacher hu.
Hanicha leman deamar kodshe mizbeach hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, ella leman deamar kodshe mizbeach lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, may ikka lememar?
Anan hachi kaamrinan: mi ikka demechayyim la mipperik, uleachar shechita mipperik? allema la mechayyim deallima kedusheteh — la mipperik, leachar shechita deakkel leh kedusheteh — mipperik!
Vela kol dechen hu? uma mechayyim deallim lemitpas pidyono — la mipperik, leachar shechita dela allim lemitpas pidyono — mipperik? ella shema minna: "lo yiggael" — lo yimmacher hu.

Velichtov rachamana "lo yimmacher"! i ketav rachamana "lo yimmacher", hava amena: izdabbone hu dela mizdabban, deka aved ovadin dechol, aval ipperoke — mipperik, deha ayyli damav lehekdesh. lehachi ketav rachamana "lo yiggael", dela izdabbone mizdabban vela ipperoke mipperik.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: lo yimmane yisrael im hakkohen labbechor, uvet hillel mattirin, vaafillu goy.
Gemara matnitin manni? rabbi akiva hi, detanya: bechor en nimnin alav ella chavura shekkullah kohanim, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: afillu zarim. rabbi akiva mattir afillu goy.
May tama devet shammay? dichtiv "uvesaram yihye lach vegomer", ma hatam kohanim — in, yisrael — la, af hacha kohanim — in, yisrael — la.

a: Uvet hillel: hane mille tam, aval baal mum ketiv "hattame vehattahor yachdav yochlennu", uma tame sheeno ochel bekadashim kallim ochel bivchor, zar sheochel bekadashim kallim eno din sheyyochal bivchor.
Ikka lemifrach: ma letame, shekken huttar mikkelalo baavodat tzibbur!
Uvet hillel, attu baavoda kaamar? baachila kaamrinan, achilat zar adif.
Verabbi akiva mattir, vaafillu goy. may tama derabbi akiva? "katztzevi vechaayyal" — ma tzevi veayyal muttar legoy, af pesulin muttar legoy.
Veiddach? telata "tzevi veayyal" ketivi, chad lechidrabbi yitzchak, vechad lechidrabbi oshaya, vechad lechidrabbi elazar hakkappar.
Veiddach? ma tzevi veayyal peturim min habbechora, af pesule hammukedashin peturin min habbechora.

Tanu rabbanan: bechor en maachilin oto leniddot, divre bet shammay. uvet hillel omrim: maachilin oto leniddot. may tama devet shammay? dichtiv: "uvesaram yihye lach", ma hatam niddot la, af hacha niddot la.
Uvet hillel: hane mille tam, aval baal mum — "hattame vehattahor yochlennu".
Uvet shammay, hane mille hecha deen tumea yotza alav miggufo, aval hecha detumea yotza alav miggufo — la.
Deashkechan defalleg rachamana ben tumea yotza alav miggufo, leven sheen tumea yotza alav miggufo, ditnan: happesach shebba betumea — lo yochlu mimmennu zavim umetzorain vezavot veniddot veyoldot.
Uvet hillel: hatam hu degalli rachamana "teme nefesh", aval hacha "tame" setama ketiv, la shena.
Tanu rabbanan: en margilin beyom tov, kayyotze bo en margilin babbechor, velo bifsule hammukedashin.
Bishlama yom tov — deka tarach tircha dela chaze leh. ella bechor — man tanna? amar rav chisda: bet shammay hi, deamar en maachilin oto leniddot.
Velo bifsule hammukedashin. man tanna? amar rav chisda: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, ditnan: hayu lefanav shete chattaot, achat temima veachat baalat mum — temima tikrav, baalat mum tippade.
Nishchata baalat mum, im ad shello nizrak damah shel temima — mutteret, im mishshennizrak damah shel temima — asura.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: afillu basar bikdera, venizrak damah shel temima — asura.
Verav chisda, lokma kulla kevet shammay! dilma ad kan la kaamri bet shammay ella bivchor, dikdushshato merechem, aval pesule hammukedashin deen kedushshato merechem — la.
b: Velokma kulla kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon! dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hatam ella pesule hammukedashin, deallimi lemitpas pidyono, aval bechor dela allim lemitpas pidyono — la.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon let leh kol pesule hammukedashin nimkarin baitliz venishkalin belitra? alma dechevan deikka ravvcha lehekdesh share le!
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: ma shemmashbiach baor — pogem babbasar. bemareva mishshemeh deravina amri: mippene shennire keoved avoda bekadashim.
Rabbi yose bar avin omer: gezera shemma yegaddel mehen adarim adarim.

Mishna bechor sheachazo dam, afillu met — en makkizin lo dam, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: yakkiz, uvilvad shello yaase bo mum, veim asa bo mum — hare ze lo yishchat alav. rabbi shimon omer: yakkiz, af al pi shehu ose bo mum.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: bechor sheachazo dam — makkizin lo et haddam bimkom sheen osim bo mum, veen makkizin lo et haddam bimkom sheosin bo mum, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: af bimkom sheose bo mum, uvilvad shello yishchat al oto hammum. rabbi shimon omer: af nishchat al oto hammum. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu met — en makkizin lo et haddam.

Matne leh rabbi elazar livreh, veamri la rabbi chiyyay livreh: kammachloket kan, kach machloket bechavit shel teruma, ditnan: chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tumea — rabbi eliezer omer: im hayta bimkom hatturepa — yannichenna bemakom hammutzena, im hayta megulla — yechassenna.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: im hayta munnachat bemakom hammutzena — yannichenna bimkom hatturepa, im hayta mechussa — yegallenna. rabban gamliel omer: lo yechaddesh bah davar.
Rabbi meir kerabbi eliezer, verabbanan kerabbi yehoshua, verabbi yehuda kerabban gamliel.
Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, deka aved beyadayim, aval hacha digrama — kerabbi yehoshua sevira leh!
Vead kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam, ella shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna, aval hacha, dei shavek leh mayet — kerabbanan sevira leh!

Vead kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha, dei shavek leh mayet, aval hatam — shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna, kerabbi eliezer sevira lehu! vead kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha, deka aved beyadayim, aval hatam digrama — kerabbi yehoshua sevira leh!
Vead kan la kaamar rabban gamliel hatam, deshemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna, aval hacha, dei shavek leh mayet, kerabbanan sevira leh!
Veod, hacha bikrae peligi vehacha bikrae peligi, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim bimchammetz achar mechammetz shehu chayyayv, dichtiv "lo teafe chametz" velo tease".
Bimsares acher mesares shehu chayyayv, dichtiv: "umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut", im al koret chayyayv, al notek lo kol shekken? ella lehavi notek achar koret, shehu chayyayv.
Lo nechleku ella bemetil mum bevaal mum, derabbi meir savar: "kol mum lo yihye bo", verabbanan savri: "tamim yihye leratzon".
Verabbi meir, hay "tamim yihye leratzon" may aved leh? mibbee leh lemaote baal mum meikkaro.
Baal mum meikkaro — peshita, dikla bealma hu!
Ella lemaote pesule hammukedashin leachar pidyonan, salka datach amena: hoil vaasiri begizza vaavoda — bemumin name littasru, ka mashma lan.
Verabbanan name, hachtiv "kol mum lo yihye bo"! ligrama hu deate, detanya: "mum lo yihye bo" — en li

a: Ella shello yitten bo mum, minnayin shello yavi devela uvatzek veyannichenna al haozen kede sheyyavo kelev veyochlenna? talmud lomar "kol mum" — echad mum veechad kol mum.
Hacha bikrae peligi, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar resh lakish, vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: "vaani hinne natatti lecha et mishmeret terumotay".
Rabbi eliezer savar: bishte terumot hakkatuv medabber, achat teruma tehora veachat teruma teluya, veamar rachamana: aved la shimmur. verabbi yehoshua: "terumati" ketiv.
Lememra derabbi eliezer savar yesh em lammikra? ureminhi: "bevigdo bah" — kevan shepperas tallito aleha, shuv eno rashshay lemochrah, divre rabbi akiva.
Rabbi eliezer omer: kevan shebbagad bah, shuv eno rashshay lemochrah!
Ella, hacha beha kamippalgi: rabbi yehoshua savar: haruya lach shemor, vesheenah reuya lach la tishmor, verabbi eliezer: ha name reuya hi, shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon. matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: he rabbi shimon? ilema rabbi shimon dematnitin, ad hasheta la ashmeinan shemuel davar sheen mitkavven muttar?

Veha rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda, verav chanin bar ashe amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon, verav chiyyay bar avin matne bela gavre — rav amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon!
Ella rabbi shimon devarayyta, verav shisha bereh derav idi matne la behedya: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon devarayyta.
Mishna hatztzorem ozen babbechor — hare ze lo yishchot olamit, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: nolad bo mum acher — yishchot alav.
Gemara umi kanes rabbi eliezer leolam? ureminhi: mi shehayta lo baheret
b: Veniktzetza — tahor, ketzatza mitkavven — rabbi eliezer omer: lichsheyyivvaled lo nega acher yithar hemennu.
Vachachamim omrim: ad shettifrach bechullo, o ad shettimat bahareto mikkigris!
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: ki kanes rabbi eliezer bemamono, begufo la kanes.
Mamono — ikka lememar deate lemebad, gufo — mi ikka lememar deate lemebad?
Amar rava: derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya?
Ella, derabbi eliezer adderabbi eliezer la kashya, kidshanninan. rabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya, hacha bemay daavad kansu, hacha bemay daavad kansu.
Bemay ikkavven lemishreyeh behay muma? behay muma kansu rabbanan, divhay muma la lishtere leh. vehacha, bemay daavad kansu — ikkavven letahore nafsheh behay ketzitza, behay ketzitza kansu rabbanan.
Bae rav pappa: "yithar" tenan, o "veyithar" tenan?
Lemay nafka minna? lechatan shennira bo nega.
Ditnan: chatan shennira bo nega — notnin lo shiva yamim, lo uleitztelito velichsuto, vechen baregel — notnin lo kol yeme haregel.
I amrat "yithar" tenan — mikkammayyta tehar leh, levatrayyta natrin leh shiva yeme mishte.
Ella i amrat: "veyithar" tenan — sof sof, ki la metammet levatrayyta, ha mittamme vekae mikkammayyta. may? teku.
Bae minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: tzorem ozen babbechor vamet, mahu liknos beno acharav?
Im timtze lomar: mocher avdo laggoyim vamet — kansu beno acharav, dechol yoma veyoma mafka leh mimmitzvot.
Im timtze lomar: kivvevn melachto bammoed vamet — lo kansu beno acharav, mishshum dela avde leissura.
Hacha may? ledideh kenasu rabbanan, veha leteh, o dilma lemamoneh kenasu rabbanan, veha iteh?

Amar leh: tenetuha, sade shennitkavvevtza bishviit — tizzara lemotzae sheviit, nittayyeyva niddayyeyra — lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit. veamar rav assi berabbi chanina: naktinan, hetivah vamet — beno zorah. alma ledideh kenasu rabbanan, livreh la kenasu rabbanan.
Amar abbaye: naktinan

a: Timme teharot vamet — lo kansu beno acharav. may tama? hezzek sheeno nikkar la shemeh hezzek, kenasa derabbanan — ledideh kenasu rabbanan, livreh la kenasu rabbanan.

Mishna maase bezachar shel rechelim zaken, usearo meduledal, veraahu kastor echad veamar: ma tivo shel ze? amru lo: bechor hu, veeno nishchat ella im ken haya bo mum. natal (paygavem) [pigyom] vetzaram ozno, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru, veachar shehittiru halach vetzerem beozne vechorot acherim veasru.

Paam achat hayu tinokot mesachakin bassade, vekashru zanve telaim ze baze, venifseka zenavo shel echad mehem, vahare hu bechor, uva maase lifne chachamim vehittiru. rau shehittiru, halchu vekashru zanvot bechorot acherim, veasru. ze hakkelal: kol shehu ledato — asur, shello ledato — muttar.
Gemara paam acheret haya kulei. utzericha, dei ashmeinan goy — dela ate lemisrach, aval katan deate lemisrach — ema la.
Vei ashmoinan katan, mishshum dela ate leichallofe begadol, aval goy deate leichallofe begadol — ema la. tzericha.
Amar rav chisda amar rav kattina: lo shanu ella daamaru leh "ella im ken haya bo mum", aval im amaru leh "im naasa bo mum" — keman daamaru leh "zil aved beh muma" dame.
Amar rava: mikkede mimmela hu, ma li "haya", ma li "naasa"? ella "naasa" name mimmela hu, vela shena.
Ze hakkelal: kol shehu ledaat — asur. leetoye may? leetoye gerama.
Shello ledaat — leetoye mesiach lefi tummo.
Mishna haya bechor rodfo, beato, veasa bo mum — hare ze shochatin alav.
Gemara amar rav pappa: lo shanu ella shebbeato bishat redifa, aval leachar redifa — la. peshita!
Mahu detema: tzareh hu demiddechar, ka mashma lan.
Ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: la tema bishat redifa — in, aval shello bishat redifa — la, ella afillu leachar redifa name. may tama? tzaareh [hu] demiddechar.
Amar rav yehuda: muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam. amar rava: gadya beudeneh, immera besifvavteh. ikka deamri: immera name beudeneh, emor derech tzedaav nefak.

Amar rava: achel vela michaze, pae umichaze — have muma. may ka mashma lan? tenena: hachutin hachitzonot — shennifgemu veshennigmemu, happenimiyyot — shenneekru. may tama? lav mishshum dechi pae michze?!
Amar rav pappa: rava name tama dematnitin mefaresh, may tama nekeru have muma — mishshum dechi pae michze.

Mishna kol hammumin haruyin lavo bide adam, roe yisrael neemanin, roim kohanim enan neemanin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: neeman hu al shel chavero, veen neeman al shel atzmo. rabbi meir omer: hechashud al haddever, lo dano velo meido.
Gemara rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: "roe yisrael" be chohanim — neemanin, lilgima la chayyshinan.
Roe kohanim be yisrael — en neemanin, memar amar: kevan deka tarachna beh, la shavek ledidi veyahev leacharine.
Vehu haddin kohen lechohen, dechayyshinan legomlin.
Vaata rabban shimon ben gamliel lememar: neeman hu al shel chavero, veeno neeman al shel atzmo. vaata rabbi meir lememar: hechashud al haddever lo dano velo meido.
Vechad amar: "roe yisrael" vehen kohanim — neemanin,
b: Memar amar: la shavek tzureba merabbanan veyahev ledidi. "roe chohanim" vehen yisrael — enan neemanin, dechayyshinan lilgima.

Vechol shekken kohen lechohen, dechayyshinan legomlin, vechayyshinan lilgima. vaata rabban shimon lememar: neeman al shel chavero, veeno neeman al shel atzmo. vaata rabbi meir lememar: hechashud al haddavar, lo dano velo meido.
Bishlama leman deamar: roe yisrael vehen kohanim neemanin — hayeynu daata rabbi meir lememar: hechashud al haddavar lo dano velo meido.
Ella leman deamar: roe chohanim be yisrael en neemanin — may ata rabbi meir leashmoinan? hayeynu tanna kamma!
Ikka benayyhu derabbi yehoshua ben kapposay, detanya: rabbi yehoshua ben kapposay omer: bechor be chohen tzarich shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu beno, afillu bitto. rabbi yose omer: afillu asara vehen bene veto en meidin alav.
Keman azla ha deamar rav chisda amar rav kattina: sefek bechor shennolad be yisrael, tzarich shenayim min hashshuk lehaid alav?
Keman? kerabbi yehoshua ben kapposay.
Rav nachman amar: bealim meidin alav, dei la tema hachi, maaser lerabbi meir mi meid alav?
Maaser vadday meheman, dei bae shade beh muma bechulleh edreh. ella sefek bechor, lerabbi meir mi meid alav?
Vechi tema, hachi name delet leh takkanta, vehatnan, shehaya rabbi yose omer: kol shechalifav beyad kohen patur min hammattanot, verabbi meir mechayyev!
Ella shema minna: bealim meidin alav, kohanim hu dachashidi ammume, yisrael la chashidi ammume.
Ittemar: rav nachman amar: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, rava amar: halacha kerabbi yose.
Umi amar rava hachi? vehaamar rava: bealim omdim immanu bachutz, nichnas shalem veyatza chavul — meidin alav! ema: kol bealim omdim, vela chayyshinan.
I hachi may lememra? mahu detema: nechush lachashada, ka mashma lan. vehilcheta kerabban shimon ben gamliel, vedavka beno uvitto, aval ishto la. may tama? ishto kegufo dame.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lerabbi meir deamar hechashud al haddavar lo dano velo meido, vekaamar rabbi meir hechashud ledavar echad chashud lechol hattora kullah, kohanim hachi name dela dayyni dina? vehachtiv "veal pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga"!

a: Emar deamar rabbi meir lachashasha, leachzokinhu mi amar?
Ibbaya lehu: ed mippi ed, mahu leedut bechor? rav assi asar, verav ashe share. amar leh rav assi lerav ashe: veha tana deve menashshe: en ed mippi ed kasher ella leedut haishsha!
Teni: ella leedut shehaishsha keshera lah bilvad.
Rav yemar achshar ed mippi ed bivchor, kare aleh marimar: "yemar share buchera". vehilcheta: ed mippi ed kasher leedut bechor.
Amar rabbi ila: lo hayu muchezakin bo shehu bechor, uva echad veamar shehu bechor umumo immo — neeman.
May ka mashma lan, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir? tenena: haishsha sheamra "eshet ish hayiti ugerusha ani" neemenet, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir!
Mahu detema: hatam hu dei baaya la amra. aval hacha, dela saggi dela amra, dekadashim bechutz la achel,
Ema: la happe sheasar hu, ka mashma lan, dei mishshum hachi — hava shade beh muma denikkar veachel leh.

Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: may shena mehahu gavra deogar leh chamara lechavreh, vaamar leh: la tezil beorcha dinhar pekod deikka mayya, zil beorcha denaresh delekka mayya. azal beorcha dinhar pekod umit chamara, vaata vaamar leh: beorcha dinhar pekod azli, umihu mayya la havo.
Vaamar rava: ma lo leshakker, i bae amar: beorcha denaresh azali. vaamar abbaye: "ma lo leshakker" bimkom edim la amrinan.

Hachi hasheta?! hatam vadday ikka mayya, hacha vadday shade beh muma — chashasha hu, uvimkom chashasha amrinan "ma lo leshakker". yatev ravina vekaamar lehay shemata bela gavra, amar leh rava zute leravina: anan mishshemeh derabbi ila matninan la.
Rabbi tzadok hava leh buchera, rema leh seare besalle, bahade dekaachel ibbeza sifteh. ata lekammeh derabbi yehoshua, amar lo: kelum chillaknu ben chaver leam haaretz? amar lo rabbi yehoshua: hen.

Ata lekammeh derabban gamliel, amar lo: chillaknu ben chaver leam haaretz? amar lo rabban gamliel: la. amar lo: (veha) [vahalo] rabbi yehoshua amar li hen! amar lo: hameten ad sheyyaalu baale terisin levet hammidrash.
Kevan shennichnesu levet hammidrash, amad hashshoel veshaal: kelum chillaknu ben chaver leam haaretz? amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lav. amar lo rabban gamliel: vahalo mishshimcha amru li hen!

Yehoshua, amod al raglecha, veyaidu becha. amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar: heach eese? ilmale ani chay vehu met — yachol hachay lehachechish et hammet, achshav sheani chay vehu chay — heach chay yachol lehachechish et hachay?
Vehaya rabban gamliel omed vedoresh, verabbi yehoshua omed al raglav, ad sherinnenu kol haam veamru lechutzepit hameturegman: amod! veamad.
Mishna neeman hakkohen lomar: hereti bechor ze uvaal mum hu.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: neeman hakkohen lomar "bechor ze natan li yisrael bemumo". may tama? kol milleta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkeri ba inashe. amar rav ashe: af anan name tenena, neeman hakkohen lomar "hereti bechor ze uvaal mum hu". may tama? lav mishshum deamrinan kol milleta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkeri ba inashe?
Hatam hu dekadashim bechutz la achel, aval hacha, kevan dachashidi — chashidi.
Metiv rav shezvi: haomer lemi sheen neeman al hammaaser "kach li mimmi shehu neeman" o "mimmi shehu measser" — eno neeman. ammay? nema: kol milleta daavida leiggalloye la meshakkeri ba inashe!
Shane hatam,
b: Deit leh leishtemote.
Sefa vadday mesayyeya leh: meish peloni — hare ze neeman.
Hatam, kevan deit leh tovea, mirtat.
Amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: mena leh lihuda ha? ana begiddul kevatay, vegiddul keva bedideh. vehachi amri leh: neeman yisrael lomar "bechor ze natatti lechohen bemumo".
Yisrael? peshita! la tzericha bekatan vehigdil, mahu detema: la kim leh? ka mashma lan.
Besura matnu kelishshana vatra, befumebdita kelishshana kamma, vehilcheta afillu kelishshana kamma.

Rafram befumebdita hava leh buchera, veyahaveh leh lechohen bela muma. azal sheda beh muma. yoma chad chalash beeneh, ayytye lekammeh. amar leh: bechor ze natan li yisrael bemumo. arpesineh leeneh, chazyeh beshikreh. amar leh: lav ana dihevteh lach?
Vaafillu hachi la chash la lemilleta, hay hu dachatzif, kulle alma la chatzifi.
Hahu sarua daata lekammeh derav ashe, amar: lemay nechush leh? i kohen hu, i yisrael hu — hare bechor umumo immo.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vedilma yisrael hu, veamar rav yehuda: en roin bechor yisrael ella im ken kohen immo!
Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam, nehi dekadashim bechutz la achel, ammamoneh dechohen chashid.
Hacha, mikkede yada dehay mum muvehak hu, may tama atyu kammeh rabbanan? mishshum kevodo dechacham; al kevodo dechacham la aved, issura aved?!
Mishna hakkol neemanin al mume maaser.
Gemara may tama? dei bae shade beh muma meikkara! mi yada he nafek?
Vechi tema mappek leh beresh asra, "lo yevakker ben tov lara" amar rachamana! ella dei bae shade beh muma (bechulle) [bechulleh] edreh.

Mishna bechor shennismet eno, veshenniktea yado, veshennishbera raglo — hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset. rabbi yose omer: afillu yesh sham esrim ushelosha, eno nishchat ella al pi mumeche.

Gemara rabbi simlay verabbi yehuda nesia tarvayyhu mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi amri, veamri la: rabbi simlay verabbi yehoshua ben levi tarvayyhu mishshum rabbi yehuda nesia amri: hattarat bechor bechutza laaretz al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset. amar rava: uvemumin muvehakin.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: bechor shennismet eno, veshenniktea yado, veshennishtabbera raglo — hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset!
I mimmatnitin hava amena: bechutza laaretz afillu mumin sheen muvehakin, vehay dekatane muvehakin — lehodiacha kocho derabbi yose, ka mashma lan.

Amar rav yehuda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba, safek mishshemeh derav, safek mishshemeh dishmuel: shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumeche. may ka mashma lan? tenena: hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset!
I mimmatnitin hava amena: bimkom mumeche, ka mashma lan: bimkom sheen mumeche — in, bimkom sheyyesh mumeche — la.
Amar rav chiyyay bar amram: shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumeche, shelosha mattirin et hanneder bimkom sheen chacham. shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumeche

a: Leappoke midderabbi yose, shelosha mefirin et hanneder bimkom sheen chacham leappoke midderabbi yehuda, detanya: hafarat nedarim bishlosha, rabbi yehuda omer: echad mehem chacham.
Bimkom sheen chacham. kegon man? amar rav nachman: kegon ana. rabbi yehuda omer: echad mehen chacham, mikkelal dehanach kol dehu? amar ravina: demasberi leh vesavar.
Rabbi yose omer: afillu yesh sham esrim ushelosha kulei. amar rav chananel amar rav: en halacha kerabbi yose. peshita, yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim! mahu detema nimmuko immo? ka mashma lan.
Tifshot meha, dehach kammayyta mishshemeh dishmuel ittemar, dei mishshemeh derav — tarte lema li?
Chada (mikkelal) [mikkelala] dachavirta ittemar.
Mishna hashshochet et habbechor, venoda shello herahu — ma sheachlu achlu, veyachzir lahem haddamim, uma shello achlu — habbasar yikkaver, veyachzir et haddamim.

Vechen hashshochet et happara umecharah, venoda shehi terefa — ma sheachlu achlu, uma shello achlu — hem yachaziru lo et habbasar, vehu yachazir lahem et haddamim. mecharuhu legoyim, o hittiluhu lichlavim — yeshallemu deme terefa.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammocher basar lachavero venimtza besar bechor, perot venimtza tevalim, yayin venimtza yen nesech — ma sheachlu achlu, veyachzir lahem et haddamim.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: devarim shehannefesh katza bahen — yachazir lahen et haddamim, vesheen hannefesh katza bahem — yenakke lahem et haddamim. veellu hen devarim shehannefesh katza bahen: nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim. veellu hen devarim sheen hannefesh katza bahen: bechorot, tevalim veyen nesech.
Bechor — velema leh: may afsedtach?
La tzericha, kegon dezabben leh mimmekom muma, daamar leh: i lav deachlat hava machzena leh veshare nihaleh, kerabbi yehuda.
Tevalim — hava matkenna lehu veachelna lehu, yen nesech — al yede taarovet, ucherabban shimon ben gamliel.
Ditnan: yen nesech shennafal labbor — kullo asur bahanaa. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yimmacher kullo legoyim, chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo.
Hadaran alach kol pesule hammukedashin.

Mishna al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor: nifgema ozno min hachaschus, aval lo haor, nisdeka af al pi shello chasra, nikkeva melo charshina, o sheyyavsha. ezehu yevesha? kol shettinnakev veenah motzia tippat dam. rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: yevesha shettehe nifrechet.
Gemara ammay? pisseach veivver ketiv!
Ketiv name "ki yihye vo mum", veema: "ki yihye bo mum" — kalal, "pisseach o ivver" — parat, kelal uferat en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; pisseach veivver — in, midde acharina — la!
"Kol mum ra" — chazar vechalal, kelal uferat uchelal — i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash — mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin, af kol mumin shebbaggaluy veenan chozrin.

Veema: ma happerat meforash — mumin shebbaggaluy, uvotel mimmelachto, veeno chozer, af kol — mumin shebbaggaluy, uvotel mimmelachto, veeno chozer. allema tenan: nifgema ozno min hachaschus velo min haor?
Kol mum ra ribbuya hu, i hachi, mumin shebbasseter name? allema tenan: chutin hachitzonot shennifgemu veshennigmemu, vehappenimiyyot shenneekru —
b: Nekeru in, nifgemu venigmemu la? baena "mum ra", velekka! i hachi, mum over name! allema tenan: velo min haor?
Mum over sevara hu, hasheta mifrak la parkinan illaveh, mishchat shachatinan illaveh? detanya: "veim kol behema temea asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban laAdonai" — bevaale mumin hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer bevaale mumin shennifdu hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella bivhema temea mammash? keshehu omer "veim bivhema hattemea", hare behema temea amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "asher lo yakrivu mimmenna"? heve omer: ze baale mumin shennifdu.
Yachol yippadu al mum over? talmud lomar: "asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban laAdonai" — mi sheenah kereva kol ikkar, yatzta zo sheenah kereva hayyom ella lemachar.
Ibbaet ema: im ken pisseach veivver lema li?
Nisdeka af al pi shello chasra. tanu rabbanan: hassedek — kol shehu, happegima — ben bide adam ben bide shamayim. mikkelal desedek bide shamayim la?
Ella, sedek ufegima — ben bide shamayim ben bide adam. vechamma shiur pegima? kede shettachgor bah tzipporen.

Nikkeva melo vechulei. tanu rabbanan: kamma nekivat haozen? melo charshina. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: bechaadasha. veezo hi yevesha? sheim tinnakev veenah motzia tippat dam. rabbi yose ben hameshullam omer: yevesha kede shettehe nifrechet.
Tana: kerovin divrehen lihyot shavin. divrehen deman? ilema detanna kamma verabbi yose ben hameshullam — tuva ikka! ella detanna kamma verabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Kaadasha — in, betzir mikkaadasha — la? ureminhi: "martzea" — en li ella martzea, minnayin lerabbot hassol, vehassira, vehammachat, vehammakdeach, vehammachtev?
Talmud lomar: "velakachta" — kol davar shennilkach bayyad, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. rabbi omer: "martzea" — ma martzea meyuchad shel mattechet, af kol shel mattechet.
Vekatane sefa: amar rabbi, yudan beribbi haya doresh: keshehen rotzin, en rotzin ella bammilat.
Vachachamim omrim: en eved ivri kohen nirtza, mippene shennaasa baal mum. veim tomar: bammilat hayu rotzin, heach eved kohen naase baal mum? ha en rotzin ella begova shel ozen.
Amar rav chana bar kattina: la kashya — kan lishchot, kan lifsol.
May karshina? amar rav sherevya: hinda.
Bea minneh rav hoshaya merav huna rabba: karshina hannichneset veyotza, o charshina haomedet? amar lo: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati.

Ditnan: hashshidra vehaggulegolet shechasru, kamma chesron bashshidra velo yehe metamme beohel? bet shammay omrim: shete chuleyot, uvet hillel omrim: chuleya achat. uvaggulegolet, bet shammay omrim: kimlo makdeach, uvet hillel omrim: kede sheyyinnatel min hachay veyamut.
Veyatev rav chisda vekamibbaya leh: "kede sheyyinnatel min hachay" — vechamma? amar leh rav tachlifa bar avudimi: hachi amar shemuel — kesela.
Veittemar: rav safra amar: shemateta amar leh, verav shemuel bar yehuda amar: matnita amar leh, vesimanaych: tane rav shemuel bar yehuda.

Vaamar leh: im ken, asita divre bet shammay vedivre bet hillel echad! ditnan: maor shello naasa bide adam, shiuro melo egrof gadol, vezehu egrofo shel ben avattiach. amar rabbi yose: veyeshno kerosh gadol shel adam.
Naasa bide adam, shiaruhu kimlo makdeach gadol shel lishka, shehu kefunedyon (shel) haitalki, uchesela nironit, veyeshno

a: Kimlo nekev shel ol! ishtik, veamar leh rav chisda: shemma makdeach vechissumo shaninu.
Vaamar leh rav tachlifa: la tema shemma, ella vadday makdeach vechissumo, tzarich lehittalot aleha kechizkiyya avi ikkesh.

Ditnan: zo edut heid chizkiyya avi ikkesh lifne rabban gamliel beyavne, sheamar mishshum rabban gamliel hazzaken: kol sheen lo toch bichli cheres — en lo achorayim lachalika. nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, nitma gabbo — nitma tocho.
Keli cheres, betocho tela rachamana — it leh toch — ittammi leh, let leh toch — la ittammi leh!
Amar rabbi yitzchak bar avin: hachi kaamar, kol sheen lo toch bichli cheres — kenegdo bichli shetef en lo achorayim lachalika, nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, nitma gabbo — nitma tocho.
Lema li lemitleyeh bichli cheres? nema: kol sheen lo toch bichli shetef — en lo achorayim lachalika!

Ha ka mashma lan, deyesh lo toch — hare hu kichli cheres; ma keli cheres, nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, lo nitma tocho — lo nitma gabbo; af keli shetef, nitma tocho — nitma gabbo, lo nitma tocho — lo nitma gabbo.
Bishlama keli cheres, galli beh rachamana "tocho", ella keli shetef, mi galli beh rachamana tocho?

I betumea deorayyta — hachi name, hacha bemay askinan? betumeat mashkin derabbanan, ditnan: keli shennitma achorav bemashkin — achorav temein, tocho ogno ozno veyadav tehorin, nitma tocho — kullo tame.
Middeorayyta, en ochel metamme keli, veen mashke metamme keli, verabbanan hu digzur mishshum mashke zav vezava.
Hilkach, shavveyu rabbanan ketumea dichli cheres, vela shavveyu rabbanan ketumea deorayyta denafsheh.
Avadu rabbanan hekkera, ki hechi dela lisrof aleh teruma vekadashim. i hachi, en lo toch name, lebed name hekkera!
Kevan daavadu hekkera beyesh lo toch, yedia deen lo toch derabbanan.
Veen lo toch bichli shetef, deorayyta bar kabbole tumea hu? dumeya desak baenan, ma sak mittaltel male verekan, af kol mittaltel male verekan.
Behanach dachazu lemidrasot. i hachi, cheres name! en midras bichli cheres.
Rav pappa amar: makdeach gadol shaninu.
Mikkelal demakdeach setam zutaro name mikkesela. hanicha lerabbi meir, ella lerabbanan may ikka lememar?
Ditnan: beeze makdeach amru? bekatan shel rofim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: begadol shel lishka.
Ulerabbi meir, mi nicha? have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel. vaanan ditnan — tenan, dela tenan — la tenan!
Amar rav nachman: sela nironit shaninu, kemakdeach gadol, sela setam zutaro mimmakdeach setam.

Mishna haris shel ayin shennikkav, shennifgam, shennisdak, hare beeno dak, tevallul, chillazon, nachash, atzav. ezehu tevallul? lavan happosek bassira venichnas bashshachor. shachor nichnas ballavan — eno mum.
b: Gemara may haris? amar rav pappa: tora bara deena. dak tevallul, tanu rabbanan: dak meshukka — hare ze mum, tzaf — eno mum.
Vehatanya ippecha! la kashya, ha bashshachor ha ballavan. veha: en mumin ballavan! ella, ha beduk lavan, ha beduk shachor.
Deamar rabba bar bar chana: sach li yoshiyya demin usha: dak shachor meshukka — hare ze mum, tzaf — eno mum. dak lavan meshukka — eno mum, tzaf — hare ze mum, vesimanaych: barka.
Chillazon nachash veatzav. ibbaya lehu: chillazon hu nachash, o dilma chillazon o nachash?

Ta shema, deamar rabba bar bar chana: sach li rabbi yochanan ben elazar, zaken echad haya bishchunatenu, verabbi shimon ben yose lakonya shemo, umiyyamay lo avarti lefanav. paam achat avarti lefanav, amar li: shev beni, shev. chillazon ze mum kavua lishchot alav, vezehu nachash sheamru chachamim.
Veaf al pi sheamru: en adam roe mumin leatzmo, aval more halacha lattalmidim, vetalmidim morin lo.
Vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna: kol talmid chacham shemmore halacha uva, im kodem maase amarah — shomin lo, veim lav — en shomin lo! ihu name more uva hava meikkara.

Ezehu tevallul? lavan happosek et hassira. matnitin manni? rabbi yose hi, detanya: lavan venichnas bashshachor, shachor venichnas ballavan — hare ze mum, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: lavan venichnas bashshachor — hare ze mum, shachor venichnas ballavan — eno mum, sheen mumin ballavan.
Amar rav: may tama derabbi yose? dichtiv: "yatza mechelev enemo", tarba deena — ikkeri, "enemo" setama — la ikkeri. verabbi meir may tameh? ma leshon "tevallul"? davar hamevalbel et haenayim.
Mishna chavarvavr vehammayim hakkevuin. ezehu chavarvavr hakkavua? kol sheshshaha shemonim yom. rabbi chananya ben antignos omer: bodkin oto shalosh peamim betoch shemonim yom.
Veellu hen mayim hakkevuin: achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim, lach veyavesh shel shelachim, o achal hayyavesh veachar kach hallach — eno mum, ad sheyyochal hallach veachar kach hayyavesh.
Gemara matnitin manni? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: chavarvavr kavua — arbaim yom, umayim hakkevuim — shemonim yom, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yehuda omer: chavarvavr — shemonim yom.
Veellu hen mayim hakkevuim: achal lach veyavesh shel bet hashshelachin, o sheachal yavesh veachar kach achal hallach — en mum ad sheyyochal yavesh achar hallach, veyeshno shelosha chodashim.
Veha tarvayyhu tenanhi: achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim, lach veyavesh shel bet hashshelachin!

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: achal lach veyavesh shel geshamim — hare ze mum, bet hashshelachin — eno mum, vehaggeshamim name, achal yavesh veachar kach achal lach — eno mum, ad sheyyochal yavesh achar hallach.

Veyeshno shelosha chodashim. ini? vehatanya — veha rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: adar venisan — lach, elul vetishri — yavesh! ema: adar vachatzi nisan — lach, elul vachatzi tishre — yavesh.
Ibbaya lehu: lach bizman lach, veyavesh bizman hayyavesh, o dilma: lach veyavesh bizman hallach?
Ta shema, deamar rav idi bar avin amar rav yitzchak bar ashyan: adar venisan — lach, elul vetishri — yavesh. dilma pere deelul vetishri maachilinan leh baadar venisan!
Vechamma maachilin oto? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi pinchas ben arova: kigrogeret. amar rava: (bae) [baan] bemareva: kigrogrot bisuda rishona,

a: O dilma bechol seuda useuda? im timtze lomar bisuda rishona — kodem achila o leachar achila? kodem achila vadday mealle leh kesamma, leachar achila may? kodem shetiyya o leachar shetiyya? vekodem shetiyya vadday mealle leh kisare, leachar shetiyya may?
Kashur o muttar? muttar — vadday mealle leh, kashur may? levaddo o im chavero? im chavero — vadday mealle leh, levaddo may?
Bair (uvassade) [o bassade]? bassade — vadday mealle leh, bair — may? bae rav ashe: im timtze lomar bassade — ginna hassemucha lair may? teku.
Rabbi chananya ben antignos omer. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: uvilvad sheyyehu meshullashim.
Bae minneh pinchas, achu demar shemuel, mishshemuel: achal vela ittassi — lemafrea have muma, o mikkan ulehabba have muma?
Lemay nafka minna? lemimal befidyono. i amrat lemafrea have muma — mael,
Vei mikkan ulehabba have muma — la mael, may? kare shemuel aleh: "pischim bazzu vaz".
Mishna chotmo shennikkav, veshennifgam, veshennisdak. sefamo shennikkeva, shennifgema, shennisdeka.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: nikkevu chovtamin ze letoch ze — mibbachutz hare ze mum, mibbifnim eno mum. sefato shennikkeva veshennifgema veshennisdeka, amar rav pappa: tora bara desifteh.
Mishna chutin hachitzonot shennifgemu, veshennigmemu, happenimiyyim shenneekru. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: en bodkin min hatteyomet velifnim, veaf lo et hatteyomet.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hatteyomet, ezehu teyomet? min hatteyomet velifnim, uteyomet atzmah kelifnim. rabbi yehoshua ben kappotzay omer: en shochatin ella al hachitzonot bilvad. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: en mashgichin al hatteyomet kol ikkar.
May kaamar? vetu, rabbi yehoshua ben kappotzay hayeynu tanna kamma!
Chassore michassera vehachi katane: ezehu happenimit? min hatteyomet velifnim, uteyomet atzmah kelifnim. bamme devarim amurim? shennifgemu veshennigmemu, aval nekeru — shochatin.

Rabbi yehoshua ben kappotzay omer: en shochatin ella al hachitzonot, aval penimiyyot shenneekru — mishchat alayyhu la shachatinan, aval ippesole mippesel. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: en mashgichin al hatteyomet kol ikkar, vaafillu ippesole la ippesil.
Bae rav achadvuy bar amme: yesh mechussar ever mibbifnim, o en mechussar ever mibbifnim? lemay? i livchor — "pisseach o ivver" ketiv,
I lekadashim, "avveret o shavur" ketiv! leishshechote uleipperoke la ibbaya lan, ki mibbaya lan leippesole — may?
"Tamim yihye leratzon" amar rachamana, tamim — in, chesron — lo. o dilma "tamim yihye leratzon", "kol mum lo yihye bo" — ma mum meabbaray, af chesron meabbaray.
Ta shema: "veet shete hakkelayot" — velo baal kuleya achat, velo baal shalosh kuleyot. vetanya iddach: "yesirenna" — lerabbot baal kuleya achat.
Savruha, dechulle alma en beriyya beachat, deha michsar chasar. lema beha kamippalgi: demar savar, chesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron, umar savar, chesron mibbifnim la shemeh chesron.
Amar rav chiyyay bar yosef: dechulle alma yesh beriyya beachat, vechesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron, vela kashya: kan — keshennivrea bishtayim vechasru, kan — keshennivrea beachat meikkara.
Veha dumeya deshalosh katane, ma shalosh meikkara, af achat meikkara!
Ella, hacha beyesh beriyya meikkara kamippalgi, mar savar: yesh beriyya beachat, umar savar: en beriyya beachat.

Verabbi yochanan amar: dechulle alma en beriyya beachat, vechesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron. vela kashya: kan shechasra kodem shechita, kan shechasra leachar shechita. uleachar shechita kodem kabbala mi shere?
b: Vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav: hatztzorem ozen happar veachar kach kibbel damo — pasul, shenneemar "velakach middam happar" — happar shehaya kevar! ella: kan shechasra kodem kabbala, kan shechasra leachar kabbala.
Uleachar kabbala kodem zerika, mi shere? vehatanya: "se tamim zachar ben shana yihye lachem", sheyyehe tamim ben shana bishat shechita.
Uminnayin bekabbala veholacha vehazzayay? talmud lomar: "yihye", sheyyehu kol havayotav tam uven shana.
Targema abben shana, hachi name mistabbera, detanya: rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer mehen kezayit basar o kezayit chelev — zorek et haddam, shema minna.
Umi ikka midde, devishat shechita have ben shana, uvishat kabbala veholacha have ben shete shanim? amar rava: zot omeret shaot poslot bekadashim.
Lema ketannae: "umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut" — kullan babbetzim, divre rabbi yehuda.

Babbetzim velo baggid? ema: af babbetzim — divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kullan baggid. rabbi yose omer: "mauch vechatut" — af babbetzim, "natuk vecharut" — baggid in, babbetzim la.
May lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: chesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron, umar savar: la shemeh chesron?
Vetisbera? rabbi yose may kasavar? i kasavar chesron mibbifnim shemeh chesron — afillu "natuk vecharut" name! vei kasavar la shemeh chesron — afillu "mauch vechatut" name la!

Ella, hacha bemumim shebbaggaluy kamippalgi. rabbi yehuda savar: "mauch vechatut" have muma, demikkavvtzan, "natuk vecharut" have muma, deha talyayn. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: "mauch vechatut" la have muma, demeikkara name zimnin demikkavvtzan, "natuk vecharut" la have muma, demeikkara name zimnin detalyayn.
Verabbi yose savar: "mauch vechatut" have muma — deha letanhu, "natuk vecharut" la have muma — deha itanhu.

Mishna nifgam hazzovan, haerya shel nekeva bammukedashin, nifgam hazzanav min haetzem, aval lo min happerek, o sherosh zanav mefatztzel, niklefa haor vehabbasar vehaetzem nishar, o sheyyesh basar mechuleya lechuleya melo etzba.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar: nifgam velo nittal, kis velo zachrut. tanya name hachi: nifgam velo nittal, kis velo zachrut. amar rabbi yose ben hameshullam: maase beinbal echad shennetalo zeev vechazar leetano.

Nifgema hazzanav min haetzem vechulei. tana: etzba sheamru — echad mearbaa betefach shel kol haadam. lemay hilcheta? amar rabba: leinyan techelet, detanya: kamma chutin hu noten? bet shammay omrim: arbaa, uvet hillel omrim: shelosha.
Vechamma tehe meshulleshet? bet shammay omrim: arbaa, uvet hillel omrim: shelosha. ushelish shebbet hillel omrim — echad mearba betefach shel kol adam.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: lishte ammot, ditnan: shete ammot hayu

a: Beshushan habbira, achat al keren mizrachit tzefonit veachat al keren mizrachit deromit, sheal keren mizrachit tzefonit hayta yetera al shel moshe chatzi etzba, vesheal keren mizrachit deromit hayta yetera aleha chatzi etzba, nimtzet yetera al shel moshe etzba.
Velama hayu achat gedola veachat ketanna? (keshehayu) [shehayu] ummanin notlin bakketanna, umachzirin baggedola, shello yavou lide meila.
Tarte lema li? chada — dechaspa vezahava, vachada — devinyayna.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak, vei tema rav huna bar natan, leotah sheshshaninu: sheyyesh basar ben chuleya lechuleya melo etzba.

Mishna en lo betzim, o en lo ella betza achat. rabbi yishmael omer: im yesh lo shene kisin — yesh lo shete betzim, en lo shene kisin — en lo ella betza achat. rabbi akiva omer: moshivo al akkuzo umemaech, im yesh betza — sofah latzet. maase shemmiech velo yatza, nishchata venimtzet devuka bakkesalim, vehittir rabbi akiva veasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri.

Gemara hasheta en lo ella betza achat amrat have muma, en lo kelal mibbaya? chassore michassera vehachi katane: en lo shete betzim bishte kisin ella bechis echad, i name shete kisin uvetza achat — hare ze mum.

Rabbi yishmael omer: yesh lo shete kisim — beyadua sheyyesh lo shete betzim, en lo ella kis echad — kemi sheen lo ella betza achat dame, vaata rabbi akiva lememar: beyadua la amrinan, ella moshivo al akkuzo umemaech, im yesh betza sofo latzet.

Umaase shemmiech velo yatza vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi yose: maase befayran shel bet menachem, shemmiech velo yatzat, venishchata venimtzet devuka bakkesalim, vehittir rabbi akiva, veasar rabbi yochanan ben nuri.

Amar lo rabbi akiva lerabbi yochanan ben nuri: ad matay atta mechalle mamonan shel yisrael! amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri lerabbi akiva: ad matay atta maachil yisrael nevelot! lav mishchat shachteh?
Ella: terefot. la issur terefot hu?! ella: ad matay atta maachil yisrael kadashim bachutz!
Mishna baal chamesh raglayim, o sheen lo ella shalosh, vesheraglav kelutot keshel chamor, vehashshachul vehakkasul. ezehu shachul? shennishmeta yerecho. vechasul? sheachat mirechotav gevohot.
Gemara amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shechaser veyater bayyad, aval baregel — terefa name have, dechol yater kenatul dame.
Amar rav pappa: la tema daagilan vela sedikan, ella kevan daagilan, af al gav disdikan.

Vehashshachul vehakkasul vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ezehu kasul veezehu shachul? shachul — shennishmeta yerecho, kasul — sheraglo echad betoch hakkesel, veraglo echad al gabbe hakkesel. tana: hassarua vehakkalut — sarua shennishtarbev lo yerecho, kalut — sheraglav kelutot keshel chamor ucheshel sus.
Mishna nishbar etzem yado veetzem raglo, af al pi sheeno nikkar. mumin ellu mana ila beyavne, vehodu lo chachamim.
Veod shelosha hosif, amru lo: lo shamanu et ellu. sheggalgal eno agol keshel adam, ufiv dome keshel chazir, veshennittal rov hamedabber bilshono. bet din shel acharehen amru: hare ze mum.
Gemara eno nikkar, mi ka have muma? amar rav pappa: eno nikkar mechamat atzmo, aval nikkar mechamat melacha.
Mumin ellu mana vechulei. lememra delav hayeynu orcheh? ureminhu: hammappelet min behema vechayya vaof, ben temein ben tehorin, im zachar teshev lezachar.
Im nekeva — teshev linkeva, eno yadua — teshev lezachar velinkeva, divre rabbi meir.
Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: may tameh derabbi meir? hoil vegalgal eno agol keshel adam! amar rav yosef: la kashya, ha beukkama, ha bechivvavra.
Ufiv dome keshel chazir. amar rav pappa: la tema dishfid uferivs, ella kevan difrivs af al gav dela shefid.
Veshennittal rov hamedabber shebbilshono. matnitin manni? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: veet shennittal rov hallashon, rabbi yehuda omer: rov hamedabber shel leshono.
Mishna umaase shehallechi hattachton odef al haelyon, veshaal rabban gamliel lachachamim, veamru: hare ze mum.

Gemara may tanna dekatane "umaase"? mishshum ditnan "piv dome lachazir", ufeligi rabbanan aleh derabbi, vekaamrinan: ki peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi bisfato elyona odefet al hattachtona, aval shehattachtona odefet al haelyona — hare ze mum.
b: Umaase name shellechi hattachton odef al haelyon, shaal rabban shimon ben gamliel lachachamim veamru: hare ze mum.

Veha gabbe adam hu ditnan: sefato haelyona odefet al hattachtona, o shettachtona odefet al haelyona — hare ze mum. gabbe adam hu dichtiv: "ish ish mizzera aharon", ish sheshshave bezaro shel aharon, aval bivhema la!
Amar rav pappa: la kashya, ha deit ba etzem, ha delet ba etzem.

Mishna ozen haggedi hayta kefula, amru chachamim: bizman shehu etzem echad — mum, bizman sheen bo etzem — eno mum. rabbi chananya ben gamliel omer: zenav haggedi shehu dome leshel chazir, vesheen bah shelosh chuleyot — hare ze mum.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: piv balum veraglav mevullamot, mechamat haruach — eno mum, mechamat haetzem — hare ze mum. oznav kefulot, bechaschasut achat — hare ze mum, bishte chaschasuyot — eno mum.
Rabban gamliel omer: zenav haggedi shehu dome leshel chazir. amar rav pappa: la tema dekattina, ella dichricha, af al gav daalima.

O sheen bah shalosh chuleyot vechulei. amar rav huna: baggedi — shetayim hare ze mum, shalosh eno mum. battale — shalosh hare ze mum, arba eno mum. metivi: baggedi — achat hare ze mum, shetayim eno mum. battale — shetayim hare ze mum, shalosh eno mum. teyuveta derav huna.
Verav huna, matnitin atiteh; ihu savar: midderesha bigdi — sefa name bigdi, vela hi — resha bigdi, vesefa betale.

Mishna rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: et sheyyabbelet beenav, veshennifgam etzem yado veraglo, veshennifrak atzmo shel piv, eno achat gedola veachat ketanna, ozno achat gedola veachat ketanna, bammare aval lo bammidda. rabbi yehuda omer: shete betzav, achat gedola kishtayim shebbachavertah, velo hodu lo chachamim.
Gemara lememra deyabbelet have muma? ureminhu: veellu sheen shochatin alehen lo bemikdash velo bammedina — baal garav uvaal yabbelet!
Vetisbera? ha ketiva "yabbelet" beorayyta! ella, la kashya: ha — begufo, ha — beeno.
Mikkede kera setama, ma li begufo uma li beeno? ella la kashya, ha deit ba etzem, ha delet ba etzem.
Dikra — deit ba etzem, matnitin — delet ba etzem; beeno — have muma, begufa — la have muma.

Velet la etzem begufa pesula? hare tiltul bealma hu, ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer: baale hattillulin pesulin baadam uchesherin babbehema! ella, idde veidde beeno, vela kashya: ha — bashshachor, ha — ballavan.
Veha en mumin ballavan! ella: idde veidde ballavan, veamar resh lakish: la kashya, ha — deit ba sear, ha — delet ba sear.
Eno achat gedola vechulei. tana: gedola keshel egel, ketanna keshel avvavz.
Ozno achat gedola vechulei. verabbanan ad kamma? tanya, acherim omrim: afillu enah lashsheniyya ella kefol — keshera.

Mishna zenav haegel — sheenah maggaat laarkov, amru chachamim: kol marbit agalim ken, kol zeman sheyyehu megaddelin — hen nimtachot. ezehu arkov sheamru? rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: bearkov shebbeemtza hayyarech.

a: Gemara tana: kefetz haelyon velo kefetz hattachton, uchenegdo begamal nikkar.
Mishna al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor, ufesule hammukedashin nifdin alehen.
Gemara ha tu lema li? ha tena leh resha: al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor! sefa itztericha: pesule hammukedashin nifdin alehen. ha name peshita — mishchat shachatinan, mifrak mibbaya?
Ella, ayyeyde ditna shelosha hosif, veamru lo: lo shamanu et ellu, vekatane veate dichidaa, veka satem la bechullehu: al ellu mumin shochatin et habbechor ufesule hammukedashin nifdin alehen.

Mishna veellu sheen shochatin alehen, lo bammikdash velo bammedina: chavavrvar, vehammayim sheen kevuin, vechutin happenimiyyot shennifgemu — aval lo shenneekru, uvaal garav, uvaal yabbelet, uvaal chazazit, zaken, vechole, umezoham, veshenneevda bo avera, veshehemit adam — al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim.
Vetumetum veanderoginos, lo bammikdash velo bammedina. rabbi shimon omer: en lecha mum gadol mizze, vachachamim omrim: eno bechor, ella nigzaz veneevad.

Gemara vegarav la? vehachtiv "garav" beorayyta! vachazazit la? vehachtiv "yallefet" beorayyta! vetanya: "garav" — ze hacheres, "yallefet" — zo chazazit hammitzrit, veamar resh lakish: lamma nikra shemah "yallefet"? shemmelappefet veholechet ad yom hammita.

Bishlama chazazit achazazit la kashya: kan bachazazit hammitzrit, kan bachazazit dealma. ella garav aggarav kashya! garav aggarav name la kashya, ha belach, ha beyavesh. lach — ittassi, yavesh — la mittasse.
Velach mittasse? vehachtiv: "yakkecha Adonai bishchin mitzrayim vegomer", umiddichtiv "uvecheres" hare garav lach amur, vekaamar: "asher lo tuchal leherafe"!

Ella, telata havo: dikra — yavesh ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, dematnitin — lach mibbachutz umibbifnim, demitzrayim — yavesh mibbifnim velach mibbachutz, dichtiv "vayhi shechin poreach avabuot baadam".
Vehazzaken vehachole vehamezoham. menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "min hatztzon umin hakkesavim umin haizzim" — perat lazzaken velachole velamzoham.
Utzerichi, dei ketav rachamana lemaote zaken, dela hadar bare, aval chole, dahadar bare — ema la. vei ketav lemaote chole, delav orcheh, aval zaken, dehayynu orcheh — ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana tere, lemaote hane dichchishi, aval mezoham dela kechish — ema la, vei name lemaote mezoham mishshum dimis, aval hane dela meisi — ema la, tzerichi.
Veshenneevda bo avera vechulei. mena hane mille?
Detanu rabbanan: "min habbehema" — lehotzi rovea venirba, "min habbakar" — lehotzi et hanneevad, "min hatztzon" — lehotzi et hammuketze, "umin hatztzon" — lehotzi et hannogeach.
Hane bene ketala ninhu! al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim.
Bishlama tumetum, bammikdash la — dilma nekeva hi, bammedina la — dilma zachar hu velet be muma.
Ella anderoginos, bishlama bammikdash la, dilma nekeva hi. ella bammedina name, nehi dezachar hu — tease nakvut charitz, veyishchot aleha!
Amar abbaye: amar kera "o charutz o shavur", charutz dumeya deshavur, ma shavur bimkom etzem, af charutz bimkom etzem.

Rava amar: bela shavur name la matzet amrat charutz bimkom basar have muma, dei salka datach have muma, kevan deamar "garav" zehu cheres, michratz charitz, dichtiv: "umarehu amok min haor", kemare chamma haamukka min hatztzel.
Velichtov rachamana "charutz" vela bae "garav", veamena: "charutz" dela meis — have muma, "garav" dimis — lo kol shekken? ketav rachamana "garav" lememar decharutz bimkom basar — la have muma.
Rabbi yishmael omer: en lecha mum gadol mizze. keabbaye la amar, charutz dumeya deshavur la amrinan.
Kerava name la amar, dilma hecha dela minnachra, aval hecha deminnechar — "mum ra" karena beh.
b: Bae rava: may tama derabbi yishmael? mifshat peshita leh anderoginos bechor hu umumo immo, o dilma sappoke mesappeka leh, veim timtza lomar" kaamar — im timtza lomar bechor hu, hare mumo immo!
Lemay nafka minna? lemilke aleh mishshum gizza vaavoda, i name lemitteve lechohen.
Ta shema: rabbi ilay omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: anderoginos bechor hu, umumo immo. shema minna mifshat peshita leh! vedilma "im timtza lomar" kaamar!
Ta shema: zachar — velo nekeva. keshehu omer lematta "zachar", sheen talmud lomar, ma talmud lomar? lehotzi tumetum veanderoginos.
Manni? illema tanna kamma — sefeka hu, veate kera lemaote sefeka?
Ella rabbanan batrae mechad kera nafki, deha gabbe bechor chad "zachar" hu dichtiv, (101) [veka] memaati kullehu minnayyhu!
Ella, peshita rabbi yishmael, vei amrat bishlama rabbi yishmael mifshat peshita leh — hayeynu deitzterich kera lemaote, ella i amrat mesappeka leh — itzterich kera lemaote sefeka?
Leolam rabbanan batrae, vegabbe bechor tarte kerae ketiv: "hazzachar" vehazzecharim".
Vachachamim omrim: eno bechor kulei. amar rav chisda: machloket beanderoginos, aval betumetum — divre hakkol sefeka hu, vekadosh missefeka.
Amar leh rava: ella meatta, baarachin yearech?

a: Allema tanya: "hazzachar" — velo tumetum veanderoginos! semi mikkan tumetum.
Ta shema: yachol lo yehe beerech ish, aval yehe beerech ishsha? talmud lomar: "hazzachar... im nekeva", velo tumetum veanderoginos! semi mikkan tumetum.
Ta shema: "im zachar im nekeva" — zachar vadday nekeva vaddait, velo tumetum veanderoginos. semi mikkan tumetum.
Ta shema: "hazzachar" — velo nekeva. keshehu omer lemattah "zachar", sheen talmud lomar; ma talmud lomar? lehotzi tumetum veanderoginos. semi mikkan tumetum.
Ta shema: hanneevad, vehammuketze, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vetumetum veanderoginos — kullan metammein begadim abbet habbelia.
Rabbi eliezer omer: tumetum veanderoginos en metammein begadim abbet habbelia, shehaya rabbi eliezer omer: kol makom shenneemar "zachar unekeva" atta motzi tumetum veanderoginos mibbenehem.
Veof, hoil velo neemar bo "zachar unekeva", en atta motzi tumetum veanderoginos mibbenehem! semi mikkan tumetum.
Ta shema: rabbi elazar omer: hatterefa, vehakkilayim, veyotze dofen, tumetum veanderoginos — lo kedoshim velo makdishin.
Veamar shemuel: lo kedoshim bitmura, velo makdishin laasot temura! semi mikkan tumetum.

Ta shema: rabbi elazar omer: chamishsha lo kedoshim velo makdishin, veellu hen: hatterefa, vehakkilayim, veyotze dofen, vetumetum, veanderoginos. vechi tema hacha name semi mikkan tumetum — havu lehu arbaa! appek tumetum, veayel yatom.

Lema ketannae? rabbi ilay omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: anderoginos bechor hu umumo immo, vachachamim omrim: en kedushsha chala alav. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: hare hu omer "hazzachar", vechol makom shenneemar "zachar" eno ella lehotzi tumetum veanderoginos.

Vechi tema: semi mikkan tumetum, rabbi shimon ben yehuda hayeynu rabbanan! ella lav tumetum ikka benayyhu, detanna kamma savar: en kedushsha chala alav aanderoginos, aval tumetum sefeka hu vekadosh missefeka, vaata rabbi shimon
b: Ben yehuda lememar: tumetum beriyya hu velo kadosh! la, dechulle alma tumetum bivriyya la mesappeka, zachar unekeva hu dimsappeka.

Metil mayim bimkom zachrut — dechulle alma la peligi dezachar hu, ki peligi bemetil mayim bemakom nakvut: mar savar chayyshinan shemma nehefcha zachruto lenakvuto, umar savar la chayyshinan. ki ha dehora rabbi elazar: bivhema metil mayim bemakom nakvut — chullin.

Tahe ba rabbi yochanan: man dela chash letanna kamma ulerabbi yishmael? velema rabbi yochanan name: man dela chash lerabbanan batrae? deamar rav chisda: machaloket beanderoginos, aval betumetum — divre hakkol sefeka!
Rabbi yochanan la sevira leh derav chisda, i la sevira leh, lema hu deamar kerabbanan batrae? hachi name kaamar: man shavek tere veaved kechad!

Verabbi elazar keman savra? ki ha deamar resh lakish: lo amru tumetum safek ella beadam, hoil vezachruto venakvuto bemakom echad, aval behema — metil mayim bemakom zachrut zachar, metil mayim bemakom nakvut nekeva.
Matkef la rav oshaya: velechush shemma nehefcha zachruto lenakvuto! amar leh: keman? kerabbi meir dechayesh lemiuta?!
Abbaye bar avin verav chananya bar avin deamri tarvayyhu: afillu tema rabbanan, hoil veishtanni ishtanni. it deamar ishtanni, veit deamar la ishtanni.
Lema ishtanni vela ishtanni tannae? detanya: tumetum shekkiddesh — kiddushav kiddushin, nitkaddesh — kiddushav kiddushin.
Vecholetz, vecholtzin leishto, umeyabbemim leishto. vetanya iddach: eshet tumetum choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Savruha, dechulle alma kerabbi akiva, deamar: seris chamma lo choletz velo meyaybem.
May lav beha kamippalgi, deman deamar choletz, vecholtzin leishto umeyabbemim et ishto, la amrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni;
Uman deamar choletzet velo mityaybemet, amrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni?
La, dechulle alma amrinan hoil veishtanni ishtanni, ha rabbi eliezer, veha rabbi akiva.
Uman tanna allibba derabbi akiva? ilema rabbi yehuda — ha vadday saris meshavve leh!
Ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: tumetum shennikra venimtza zachar — hare ze lo yachlotz, mippene shehu kesaris!
Ella rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, detanya: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: tumetum lo choletz, shemma yikkara veyimmatze saris chamma.
Attu kol demikkera zachar mishtechach, nekeva la mishtechach? shemma kaamar, shemma yikkara veyimmatze nekeva.
I name zachar name, shemma yimmatze saris chamma. may benayyhu? amar rava:

a: Lifsol bimkom achim,
Velachlotz shello bimkom achim, ikka benayyhu.
Hadaran alach al ellu mumin.
Mishna mumin ellu, ben kevuin ben ovrim — poslin baadam, veyater alehen: hakkilon, vehallaftan, vehammakkavan, vesherosho shakut, usekifat.
Uvaale chatarot — rabbi yehuda machshir, vachachamim poslin. hakkereach pasul. ezehu kereach? kol sheen lo shita shel sear mukkefet meozen leozen, im yesh lo — hare ze kasher.
Gemara ammay? vehaikka yabbelet, dela ketiv beorayyta beadam! vetu: dak tevallul, dela ketivi bivhema!

Melaf yalfi mehadade, detanya: baadam lo neemar bo yabbelet, babbehema lo neemar dak tevallul, minnayin litten et haamur shel ze baze veet haamur shel ze baze? talmud lomar: "garav" "garav", "yallefet" "yallefet" ligzera shava.
Mafne, dei la mafne, ikka lemifrach: adam mibbehema la yalef, shekken hi atzmah kereva legabbe mizbeach; behema meadam la yalfa, shekken nitrabba bemitzvot.
Laye, afnoye mafne, lichtov rachamana "yallefet" vela bae "garav", vaana amena: uma yallefet dela meisa have muma, garav dimis lo kol shekken? "garav" "garav" dichtav rachamana lema li? leafnoye.
Velichtevinhu rachamana kullehu bechad, vegarav veyallefet hacha vehacha, velelfu mechada!
Aheyay behe lichtov rachamana? i ketav beadam, hava amena: kol defasul beadam pasul bivhema, kalut vechutin deletanhu beadam, bivhema name la lippaslu.
Velichtov rachamana kullehu bivhema, have amena: kol defasul bivhema pasul beadam, gibben vecharum deletanhu bivhema — beadam name la lippaslu.
Velichtevinhu rachamana kullehu bechad, vehanach deletanhu beiddach — lichtov rachamana bivhema, vehanach deletanhu beiddach — lichtov beadam, vegarav veyallefet — hacha vehacha, velelfi mehadade.
Ella, ketanna deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: kol parasha shenneemra venishnet — lo nishnet ella bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah.
Amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana mum beadam, mum bekadashim, mum bivchor?
Tzericha, dei ketav rachamana mum beadam, shekken nitrabba bemitzvot. adam mibbechor behema la ate, shekken hu atzmo karev legabbe mizbeach.
Kadashim mibbechor la ate, shekken kedushshato merechem.
Adam mikkodashim la ate, shekken hen atzman kerevin. bechor mikkodashim la ate, shekken kedushshato merubba.
Chada mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte? mehe tete?! la lichtov rachamana bivchor, vetete mehanach? ma lehanach shekken kedushshatan merubba, venohagin bifshutin.
Bekadashim, vetete mehanach? ma lehanach shekken kedushshatan mealehen!
Beadam, vetete mehanach? ma lehanach shekken hen atzman kerevin legabbe mizbeach! tzerichi.
Yater alehen beadam. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "kol ish asher bo mum mizzera aharon", ish sheshshave bezaro shel aharon.
b: May ikka ben muma lesheeno shave bezaro shel aharon? ikka mishshum achole avoda: muma machel avoda, dichtiv: "mum bo velo yechallel", sheeno shave bezaro shel aharon la machel avoda.
May ikka ben sheeno shave bezaro shel aharon, umishshum marit haayin? ikka benayyhu ase.
Kilon — dedame resheh leachla, "lafta" — dedame resheh legadgalida delifta, tana: vetzavvaro omed beemtza rosho.

Makkavan — dedame resheh lemakkavan, "vesherosho shakut" — millefanav, "usekifat" — meachorav, kidamri inashe: shekil pissa. tana: vetzavvaro shakut veshamut. "shakut" — dachavis michbas, "shamut" — daarich ushemit.
Uvaale chatarot rabbi yehuda kulei. deit beh etzem, kulle alma la peligi defasla. ki peligi — delet beh etzem: mar savar — ha eno shave bezaro shel aharon, umar savar — kirkura devisra bealma hu.
Hakkereach pasul. amar rava: lo shanu ella sheen lo leacharav veyesh lo lefanav, aval yesh lo leacharav — kasher, vechol shekken sheyyesh lo leacharav veen lo lefanav.

Veikka dematne assefa, veim yesh lo — hare ze kasher. amar rava: lo shanu ella sheyyesh lo leacharav veen lo lefanav, aval yesh lo ben leacharav ben lefanav — pasul, vechol shekken sheyyesh lo lefanav veen lo leacharav, udeen lo kelal — defasul.
Amar rabbi yochanan: hakkarchanin vehannannasin vehazzavleganin — pesulin, lefi sheenan shave bezaro shel aharon. karchanin — tenena! nannasin — tenena!
Zavleganin itzterich leh leashmoinan, umahu detema mishshum marit haayin.
Veha kol hecha deikka mishshum marit haayin (itna) [mitna] katane, veshennashru rise enav pasul mippene marit haayin! mahu detema: tane chada, vehu haddin lechullehu.

Veha kol hecha deikka mihdar umitna, ka hadar vetane: veshennittelu shinnav pasul mishshum marit haayin! ella, leappoke meha detanya, detanya: hakkarchanin vehannannasin vehazzavleganin kesherim, velo amru pasul ella mishshum marit haayin.
Man hay tanna? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: "hakkohanim" — lerabbot hakkarchanin.

Mishna en lo gevinin, o en lo ella gevin echad — zehu gibben haamur betora. rabbi dosa omer: (sheggevinin) [sheggevinav] shochvin. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: sheyyesh lo shene gabbin ushete shidraot.
Gemara vegibben — deen lo mashma? ureminhu: "gibben" — sheyyesh lo gevinin harebe, en lo gevinin, o en lo ella gevin achad — minnayin? talmud lomar: "o gibben". amar rava: zehu midrash "o gibben".
Rabbi dosa omer kulei. lememra dechaye? veha ittemar: hammappelet beriyya sheyyesh lah shene gabbin ushete shidraot, veamar rav: baishsha — eno vavlad, babbehema — asur baachila!
Kevar rema nihaleh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav, vaamar leh: shimi et! ella besheshshidrato akumma.

Mishna hecharum pasul. ezehu charum? hakkochel shete enav keachat. shete enav lemala, ushete enav lematta, eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta, roe et hacheder veet haaliyyay keechad, sache shemesh, vehazzagdan, vehatztzayran, veshennashru rise enav — pasul mippene marit haayin.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "charum" — shechotmo shakua, chotmo soled, chotmo bolem, chotmo notef, minnayin? talmud lomar: "o charum". rabbi yose omer: en "charum" ella hakkochel shete enav keachat. amru lo: hiflagta,

a: Af al pi sheeno kochel shete enav keachat.

Shete enav lematta. ma "shete enav lemala" "shete enav lematta"? illema shete enav lemala — dechaze lemala, shete enav lematta — dechaze lematta, eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta — dachazay eno achat lematta veeno achat lemala, hayeynu "roe et hacheder veet haaliyyay keechat"!

Ella, shete enav lemala — dekayyman lemala, shete enav lematta — dekayyman lematta, eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta — dekayymi eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta, vekayymi kesidran name, veroe et hacheder veet haaliyyay keachat.

Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: beeno — kol ma shebbeeno, mikkan amru: shete enav lematta, shete enav lemala, eno achat lemala veeno achat lematta, veroe et hacheder veet haaliyyay keechat, o shemmedabber im chavero veacher omer: li roe.
Tanu rabbanan: ivver — ben some bishte enav, ben some beachat meenav. chavarvavr vehammayim hakkevuin minnayin? talmud lomar: "ish ivver".

Amar rava: lema li dichtav rachamana "ish", "ivver", "dak", "tevallul", "beeno"? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "ivver" mishshum deletanhu kelal, aval chavarvavr vehammayim hakkevuin deitanhu beh — la, ketav rachamana "ish".

Vei ketav rachamana "ish" — mishshum dela ka chaze kelal, aval machsorayyta — la, ketav rachamana "dak". vei ketav rachamana "dak" — mishshum dimchasseran, aval mevalbelita — la, ketav rachamana "tevallul".
Vei ketav rachamana "tevallul" — mishshum dimvalbelan, aval mishshum meshanneyuta — la, ketav rachamana "beeno".
Amar rava: hilkach, kol mechamat kahyuta — atya meish", machsorayyta — middak", mevalbelita — mittevallul", meshanneyuta — mibbeeno".
Sache shemesh. tane rav yosef: "sane shemesh". zagdeyayn. machve rav huna: chad middidan vechad middidhu, veikkefad rav yehuda.
Metivi: shachvana — sheggevinav shochvim, zagdom — echad shachor veechad lavan. tanna: kol zuga dela shave lahadade, "zagdom" kare leh.
Hatztzayran. enav terutot, vetziraniyyot, domot, dolfot, tordot.

Tanna: hazzidder vehallufeyan (vehattamir) [vehattimyan]. zivver — dimzavvar eneh, lufeyan — dinfishin zifeh, (tamir) [timyan] — shettammu (zifin) [zifav]. vehane gabbe mumin tanu lehu? vehatnan: shennashru rise enav pasul mippene marit haayin! la kashya, ha deishteyur gardume, ha dela ishteyur gardume.

Mishna enav gedolot keshel egel, o ketannot keshel avvavz. gufo gadol meevarav, o katan meevarav. chotmo gadol meevarav, o katan meevarav. hatzivmmem vehatztzivmmea — ezehu tzivmmea? kol sheoznav ketannot, vehatztzivmmem — kol sheoznav domot lisfog. sefato haelyona odefet al hattachtona, hattachtona odefet al haelyona — hare ze mum. veshennashru shinnav — pasul mippene marit haayin.
Gemara amar rav: moshe rabbenu eser ammot haya, shenneemar: "vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan", mi peraso? moshe rabbenu peraso, uchetiv: "eser ammot orech hakkaresh".
Amar leh rav shimi bar chiyyay lerav: im ken asito lemoshe rabbenu baal mum! ditnan: gufo gadol meevarav o katan meevarav. amar leh: shimi! beamma shel kodesh kaamena.
Chotmo gadol vechulei. tana: keetzba ketanna.
Hatztzivmmem vehatztzivmmea. tana: af hatztzimmeach. la havo yadi rabbanan may "tzimmeach", shemau lehahu tayyaya dahava kaamar: "man devae tzimmeach", veishtechach gadya chaziza.
Amar rav chisda: ez sheen lah karnayim, verachel sheyyesh lah karnayim — kesherim legabbe mizbeach.

Tanya name hachi: yesh devarim shehen kemumin, veenan kemumin, veshochatin alehem bemikdash, aval lo bammedina. veellu hen: ez sheen (lo) [lah] karnayim, verachel sheyyesh (lo) [lah] karnayim, vehatztzimmeach, vehatztzimmem, vehatztzimmea.
Amar rav chisda amar ammemar: nittelu karnotan vezachrutan immahen — pesula, veen podin alehem. nittelu telafayim vezachrutam immahen — pesulin, venifdin alehem.
Metivi: nittelu karnayin utelafayin vezachrutan immahen — pesulin venifdin alehen! la kashya: ha deitakur itakore, ha deiggum iggome.
Udeiggum iggome, pasul? ureminhu: para shekkarneha utelafeha shechorim — yagod! targema zeeri: meillave zachrut.
b: Mishna daddin shochvin keshel ishsha, kereso tzava, tibburo yotze, nichpe — afillu achat leyamim, ruach ketzara baa alav, hameusheban, uvaal gever.

Gemara amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: mashtinin mayim bifne rabbim, veen shotin mayim bifne rabbim. vetanya name hachi: mashtinin mayim bifne rabbim, veen shotin mayim bifne rabbim. umaase beechad shebbikkesh lehashetin mayim velo hishtin, venimtza kereso tzava.
Shemuel itzterich leh beshabbeta derigla, negadu leh gelima, ata lekammeh daavu, amar leh: etten lach arba mea zuze vezil ahdar ovada. at — deefshar lach, dela efshar leh — listakkan.
Mar bar rav ashe itzterich aggudda gamla, ashten. amaru leh: chamatach kaatya! amar lehu: beudena.
Vetippok li mishshum alka! beshotet.
Tanu rabbanan: shene nekavim yesh bo baadam, echad motzi sheten veechad motzi shichvat zera, veen ben ze laze ella kiklippat hashshum. beshaa sheadam nitzrach, im nikkevu ze letoch ze — nimtza akar.
Amar resh lakish: may dichtiv "lo yihye vecha akar vaakara uvivhemtecha"? ematay lo yihye vecha akar? bizman shebbivhemtecha".
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "lo yihye vecha akar" — min hattalmidim, "vaakara" — shello tehe tefillatecha akura lifne hammakom. ematay? bizman sheatta mesim atzmecha kivhema.

Amar rav pappa: lo yashtin adam mayim lo al kele cheres, velo al mekom kashe, deamar rav: hane medore devavel mehadderi mayya leen etam. amar abbaye: ha itteta la tekum lehedya beanpe yanoka, aggisa let lan ba.

Tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ammud hachozer mevi adam lide hidrokan, silon hachozer mevi adam lide yerakon. amar rabba bar rav huna, amar rav kattina, amar resh lakish: dam rave — shechin rave, shichvat zera rava — tzaraat rava, tzoa rava — hidrokan rave, me raglayim ravin — yerakon rave.
Ruach katzrit baa alav. may ninhu? tana: ruach ben nefalim baa alav.
Hameusheban uvaal gever. tana: meshubban babbetzim, uvaal gever baggid. tana: meshubban — ze hakkayyayn, hageravtan — ze baal kik; kayyayn — babbetzim, geravta — baggid.
Vead kamma? machve rav yehuda: ad rechubba. tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ad rechubba — pasul, lemala min rechubba — kasher. ikka deamri: ad rechubba — kasher, lematta min harchubba — pasul.

Mishna en lo betzim, o en lo ella betza achat — hare ze "meroach ashech" haamur betora. rabbi yishmael omer: kol shennimmochu ashachav. rabbi akiva omer: kol sheruach baashachav. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: kol shemmarav chashuchin.
Gemara kashya leh lerabbi yishmael: ha "chasar ashech" mibbee leh! teni: shennimrechu ashachav. kashya leh lerabbi akiva: hay "mamroach ashech" mibbee leh! teni: sheharuach baashachav.
Kashya leh lerabbi chanina ben antignos: hay "ruach ashech" mibbee leh! teni shemmarav chashuchin, kasavar gorin umosifin vedorshin.
Hayeynu kushi! rabbi chanina ben antignos la tane "kushi".
Mishna makkish bekarsullav, uvearchubbotav,

a: Uvaal happikim, haikkel. ezehu haikkel? kol shehu makkif parsotav veen arkubbotav nokshot zo lazo. pikka yotze migguddalo, akevo yotze laachorav, parsotav rechavot keshel avvavz.
Etzbeotav murekavot zo al zo, o kelutot lemala ad happerek — kasher, lematta min happerek vachatachah — kasher, hayta bah yeteret vachatachah, im yesh bah etzem — pasul, veim lav — kasher.
Yater beyadav uveraglav, shesh vashesh — esrim vearba, rabbi yehuda machshir vachachamim poslin. hashsholet bishte yadav — rabbi posel vachachamim machshirin.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shever ragel — en li ella shever regel, minnayin lerabbot hakkishan vehaikkel vehakkilban? talmud lomar: "o shever ragel". tana: baal hakkippin vehashshufenar. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: baal happikkin — sheyyesh lo kesatot harebe, shufenar — sheen lo kesatot kol ikkar.

Pikka yotza migguddalo, vaakevo yotze laachorav. amar rabbi elazar: shoko yotze baemtza raglo. parsotav rechavot keshel avvavz. amar rav pappa: la tema ditrifa vela sedika, ella kevan ditrifa, af al gav disdika.
Etzbeotav murekavot zo al gav zo, o kelutot. tanu rabbanan: "shever yad" — en li ella shever yad.
Etzbaot murekavot lemala o kelutot lemala min happerek, vehaamrat kasher! ella velo chatachan, minnayin? talmud lomar: "o shever yad".
Hayta bo yeteret vachatachah, im yesh bah etzem — pasul, veim lav — kasher. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shennisperet al gabbe hayyad.

Tanu rabbanan: yetera sheyyesh bah etzem, veen bah tzipporen — metamma bemagga uvemassa, umetamma beohel, veola leminyan mea veesrim vachamishsha. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: uvenisperet al gav hayyad.

Amar rav chisda: davar ze rabbenu haggadol amaro, hammakom yihye beezro: yeteret sheyyesh bah etzem veen bah tzipporen — metamma bemagga uvemassa, veen metamma beohel. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: uvesheenah nisperet al gav hayyad.
Amar rabbi yochanan: asu divrehem kedivre neviut, ma nafshach? i ever hu — beohel name tetamme, vei lav ever hu — bemagga uvemassa name la litamme!
Amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: mishshum etzem kisora nagu bah.
Rav pappa amar: gezera sheenah nisperet, attu nisperet. i hachi, sheenah nisperet beohel name tetamme!
Avadu rabbanan hekkera, ki hechi dela lisrefu alayyhu teruma vekadashim.

Tenan hatam: rov binyano verov minyano shel met, af al pi sheen bo rova — temein. tanu rabbanan: ezehu rov binyano? shene shokayim veyarech echad, hoil verov govho begadol. ezehu rov minyano? mea veesrim vachamishsha.

Amar leh ravina lerava: tanna minyayna ata leashmoinan? ka mashma lan kidtanya: chaser, sheen bo ella matayim, veyater, sheyyesh bo matayim ushemonim veechad — kullan olin leminyan mea veesrim vachamishsha, zil batar rubba deinashe.

Amar rabbi yehuda amar shemuel: maase betalmidav shel rabbi yishmael sheshshalku zona achat shennitchayyeyva serefa lammelech, badku umatzu bah matayim vachamishshim ushenayim, amar lahem: shemma beishsha bedaktem, shehosif lah hakkatuv shene tzirim ushene delatot.

Tanya, rabbi elazar omer: keshem shetztzirim labbayit — kach tzirim laishsha, shenneemar: "vattichra vatteled ki nehefchu aleha tzireha". rabbi yehoshua omer: keshem sheddelatot labbayit — kach delatot laishsha, shenneemar: "ki lo sagar dalte vitni".
Rabbi akiva omer: keshem shemmafteach labbayit, kach mafteach laishsha, shenneemar: "vayyiftach et rachmah". lerabbi akiva kashya detalmide rabbi yishmael! dilma ayyeyde dezutar ittemoche mittemach.
Amar rav: vechullan en metammein beohel, shenneemar: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel", davar hashshave lechol adam.

Amar leh abbaye: uveish lekka? vehachtiv: "tzirim achazuni ketzire yoleda"! tzire vasar. vehachtiv: "adoni bammara nehefchu tziray"! hacha name tzire vasar. hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi, matayim vearbaim ushemone hechi mashkachat la? la beish vela beishsha.
b: Yater beyadav uveraglav. amar rabbi yitzchak: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, vattehi od milchama, uchetiv: "vayhi ish madon etzba yadav veetzba raglav shesh vashesh", mar savar bignuteh mishtae, umar savar bishvacheh mishtae.

Amar rabba: ma li dichtiv "shesh vashesh esrim vearba mispar"? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana "shesh vashesh" hava amena: shet dideh veshet dechareh, ketav "esrim vearba". vei ketav "esrim vearba" hava amena: hu chamesh mehay gisa usheva mehay gisa, ketav "shesh vashesh". "mispar" — benisperet al gabbe hayyad.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi tarfon, yater beyadav uveraglav shesh vashesh esrim vearba. amar lo: kemotcha yirbu beyisrael! amar lo rabbi yose: mishsham reaya? kach amar lo: kemotcha yitmaatu mamzere unetine miyyisrael!

Hashsholet bishte yadav. tanu rabbanan — itter, ben bayyad ben baregel — pasul. hashsholet bishte yadav — rabbi posel vachachamim machshirin. mar savar — kechishuta atchila beyamin, umar savar — beriyyuta atchila bismol.

Mishna hakkushi, haggichor, vehallavkan, vehakkippeach, vehannannas, vehacheresh, vehashshote, vehashshikkor, uvaale negaim tehorim — pesulin beadam uchesherim babbehema. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shota min habbehema enah min hammuvechar. rabbi elazar omer: af baale haddildulin pesulin baadam uchesherin babbehema.

Gemara kushi — ukkama, gichor — chivvavra, lavkan — summaka. ini? veha hahu daamar lehu "man bae lukeyane", veishtechach chivvavra! ella: kushi — ukkama, gichor — summaka, kidamri inashe: "summaka gichya", lavkan — chivvavra, kehahu daamar lehu "man bae lukeyane", veishtechach chivvavre.

Kippeach. tane rav zevid: gavoah. ini? vehatane rabbi avahu: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mishtabbeach bevaale koma, shenneemar: "veanochi hishmadti et haemori mippenehem asher kegova arazim govho". amar rav pappa: baaricha shemita sanya.

Amar resh lakish: gavoah lo yissa gevohit — shemma yetze mehen toren, nannas lo yissa nanneset — shemma yetze mehem etzbai, lavan lo yissa levana — shemma yetze mehem bohek, shachor lo yissa shechora — shemma yetze mehen tafuach.
Hacheresh, hashshote, vehashshikkor. shikkor machel avoda, bahade mume demachayli avoda bae lemichshav!
Bishar devarim hameshakkerim. udela kerabbi yehuda, detanya: achal devela keilit, veshata chalav o devash, nichnas lammikdash — chayyayv.
Mishna ellu kesherin baadam ufesulin babbehema: oto veet beno, terefa, veyotze dofen, veshenneevda bahen avera, veshehemit et haadam.
Vehannose nashim baavera — pasul ad sheyyaddirenna hanaa, vehammittamme lemetim — pasul ad sheyyekabbel alav shello yehe mittamme lemetim.
Gemara veellu kesherin baadam, may (beoto) ["oto] veet beno"?
Illema aharon uvanav, dichvateh tayish uveno, mi naheg? vehatanya: "oto veet beno" noheg binkevot, veeno noheg bizcharim! ella teyaysha uvenah, dichvavta hacha kohenet uvenah, kohenet bat avoda hi?

Leolam aharon uvanav, dichvavta hacha tayish uveno. amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose bar avin: ada amra chananya hi, detanya: "oto veet beno" noheg binkevot veeno noheg bizcharim, chananya omer: noheg bizcharim uvinkevot.
Vehannose nashim kulei. tana: noder veoved, yored umegaresh.
Velechush dilma azel legabbe chacham veshare leh! kasavar: tzarich lefaret et hanneder.
Hanicha leman deamar tzarich lefaret et hanneder, ella leman deamar en tzarich lefaret et hanneder, may ikka lememar? demadderinan leh berabbim.
Hanicha leman deamar neder shehuddar berabbim en lo hafara, ella leman deamar yesh lo hafara, may ikka lememar? demadderinan

a: Leh addaat rabbim.

Amar ammemar: hilcheta, afillu leman deamar neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara, al daat harabbim en lo hafara. vehane mille lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva yesh lo hafara. ki hahu demakre dardeke, addereh rav acha deka fasha beyanoke, veahdereh ravina, dela ashkach dahava dayek kevavteh.
Vehammittamme lemetim kulei. may shena hacha desaggi leh bekabbala, umay shena hatam demadderinan leh? hatam yitzro tekafo.
Hadaran alach mumin ellu.
Mishna yesh bechor lannachala, veeno bechor lakkohen; bechor lichhen, veeno bechor lannachala; bechor lannachala velakkohen, veyesh sheeno bechor lo lannachala velo lakkohen.
Ezehu bechor lannachala veeno bechor lakkohen? habba achar nefalim, af al pi sheyyatza et rosho chay, uven tisha sheyyatza rosho met, hammappelet kemin behema chayya vaof — divre rabbi meir.
