Vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyehe bo mitztzurat adam. hammappelet sandal, o shilya, o shappir merukkam, vehayyotze mechuttach — habba acharehem bechor lannachala, veen bechor lakkohen.
Mi shello hayu lo banim, venasa ishsha shekkevar yalda, odah shifcha venishtachrera, odah nochrit venitgayyeyra, mishshebbat leyisrael yalda — bechor lannachala veen bechor lakkohen.
Rabbi yose haggelili omer: bechor lannachala velakkohen, shenneemar: "peter rechem beyisrael" — ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael.
Mi shehayu lo banim venasa ishsha shello yalda, nitgayyeyra meubberet, nishtachrera meubberet.

Veyalda hi vechohenet hi, uleviyya hi, veishsha shekkevar yalda, vechen mi shello shahata leachar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda, veeno yadua im ben tisha larishon im bin shiva laacharon — bechor lakkohen veeno bechor lannachala.
b: Gemara amar shemuel: en harosh poter binfalim.
May tama? "kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav" — kol hecha denishmat ruach chayyim beappav hu dachashiv resheh, iddach la chashiv resheh.
Tenan: habba achar nefalim, sheyyatza rosho chay, uven tisha sheyyatza rosho met. katane miha "rosho!" may "rosho?" rubbo.

Velitne "rubbo"! bedin hu deibbei leh lemitne rubbo, veayyeyde deka vae lemitne sefa ben tisha sheyyatza rosho met — tama derosho met, ha rosho chay — habba acharav bechor lannachala name la have, tena resha name rosho.
Umay ka mashma lan, dechevan demappek leh resheh have [leh] leda? tenena: hotzi rosho, af al pi shehechziro — hare ze keyalud!
Vechi tema: ashmoinan behema, veka mashma lan beadam, deadam mibbehema la yalef — delet la perozdor.
Behema meadam la yalfa — mishshum dachashiv partzuf panim dideh.
Ha name tenena: yatza kedarko — mishsheyyatza rov rosho, veezehu rov rosho? mishshettetze paddachto. teyuveta dishmuel, teyuveta!
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: paddachat poteret bechol makom, chutz min hannachala. may tama? "yakkir" amar rachamana, verabbi yochanan amar: afillu lannachala.
Bechol makom, leetoye may? leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: giyyoret sheyyatza paddachat veladah begayyutah, veachar kach nitgayyeyra — en notnin lah yeme tumea vime tohora, veenah mevia korban leda.
Metivi: "yakkir" — zo hakkarat panim, veezo hi hakkarat panim? partzuf panim im hachotem. tane: "ad hachotem". ta shema: en meidim ella al partzuf panim im hachotem. teni: "ad hachotem".

Ta shema: paddachat belo partzuf panim, partzuf panim belo paddachat — en meidin ad sheyyehu shenehem im hachotem. veamar abbaye, veittema rav kahana: may keraa? "hakkarat penehem anta bam"! shane edut ishsha, deachmiru ba rabbanan.
Umi achmiru? veha tenan: huchezku lihyot massiim ed mippi ed, mippi ishsha, mippi eved, mippi shifcha! ki akkilu rabbanan besofah, bitchillatah la akkilu rabbanan.
Veibbaet ema:

a: "Yakkir" lechud, vehakkarat panim lechud.

Ittemar: hayu lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer — rabbi yochanan omer: en lo bechor lannachala, verabbi shimon ben lakish omer: yesh lo bechor lannachala. rabbi yochanan omer: en lo bechor lannachala — deha hava leh "reshit ono", verabbi shimon ben lakish omer: yesh lo bechor lannachala — ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame.

Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: hayu lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer — rabbi yochanan amar: kiyyem periyya ureviyya, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: lo kiyyem. rabbi yochanan amar: kiyyem — "lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah", verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: lo kiyyem periyya ureviyya — ger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad dame.

Utzericha, dei ittemar beha kammayyta, beha kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, mishshum divgayyutan lav bene nachala ninhu, aval beha ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan, delo tohu beraah lashevet yetzarah", veha avad leh shevet.
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yochanan, aval beha ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish, tzericha.
Tenan: mi shello hayu lo banim, venasa ishsha shekkevar yalda, odah shifcha venishtachrera, odah goya venitgayyeyra, umishshebbata leyisrael yalada — veladah bechor lannachala veeno bechor lakkohen.
Yalda mimman? ilema miyyisrael shello hayu lo banim — may irya giyyoret veshifcha? afillu bat yisrael name!
Ella lav migger shehayu lo banim venitgayyer, vekatane bechor lannachala!
La, leolam miyyisrael shello hayu lo banim, veeno bechor lakkohen" itztericha leh.
Leappoke midderabbi yose haggelili, deamar: bechor lannachala velakkohen, shenneemar: "peter rechem beyisrael" — ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael, ka mashma lan dela.

Ta shema: hayu lo banim begayyuto venitgayyer, yesh lo bechor lannachala! amar ravina, veittema rav acha: ha vadday rabbi yose haggelili hiv, deamar "peter rechem beyisrael" — ad sheyyifteru rechem miyyisrael, veyalef ihu minna dida.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: leviyyay sheyyalda — benah patur mechamesh selaim. deiabbar mimman? ilema deiabbar mikkohen umillevi, may irya leviyyay? afillu yisreelit name!
Ella deiabbar miyyisrael, "lemishpechotam levet avotam" ketiv!
Amar rav pappa: deiabbar miggoy. vela tema allibba deman deamar en mezahamin et havvalad, ella afillu leman deamar mezahamin et havvalad, levi pasul mikkere.
Mar bereh derav yosef amar mishshemeh derava: leolam deiabbar miyyisrael, veshane hatam, deamar kera "peter rechem" — befeter rechem tela rachmana.
Tenan: mi shehayu lo banim venasa ishsha shello yalada, nitgayyeyra meubberet, nishtachrera meubberet.

Veyalda hi vechohenet hi, uleviyya hi, veishsha shekkevar yalada. vechen mi shello shahata achare balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalada, veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon — bechor lakkohen veeno bechor lannachala.
Mikkelal (dichhunna) [dechohenet] uleviyya peturin, deiabbar mimman? ilema deiabbar mikkohen velevi — i hachi may irya kohenet uleviyya? afillu bat yisrael name!

Ella deiabbar miggoy — kohenet petura? vehaamar rav pappa: badek lan rabba, kohenet shennitabbera miggoy mahu? veamena leh: lav hayeynu derav adda bar ahava, deamar: leviyya sheyyalda benah patur mechamesh selaim?
Vaamar li: hachi hasheta?! bishlama leviyya bikdusheta kayyma, detanya: leviyya shennishbet o shennivala beilat zenut — notnin lah min hammaaser veochelet.
Ella kohenet, kevan dei bael la, havya zara!
Hanicha lemar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava, deamar deiabbar miyyisrael, moke la bidiabbar miyyisrael, ella lerav pappa bemay moke lah?
Leolam deiabbar mikkohen, vehi bat yisrael, veammay kare la "kohenet"? divna kohen.
b: Ittemar: kohen shemmet vehinniach ben chalal — rav chisda amar: habben chayyayv lifdot et atzmo, rabba bar rav huna amar: en chayyayv lifdot et atzmo. kol hecha demet haav leachar sheloshim, dechulle alma la peligi deen habben chayyayv lifdot et atzmo, shehare zacha aviv befidyono.

Ki peligi hecha demet haav betoch sheloshim yom, rav chisda amar: habben chayyayv lifdot et atzmo, deha lo zacha aviv (lefidyono) [befidyono]. rabba bar rav huna amar: en habben chayyayv lifdot atzmo, daamar leh: atena mikkoach gavra dela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadeh.
Tenan: nitgayyeyra meubberet — bechor lakkohen, veammay? lema leh: atena mikkoach gavra dela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadeh! shane goy delet leh chayis.

Amar rabbi shimon yasinya, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kohen shemmet betoch sheloshim vehinniach ben chalal — habben chayyayv lifdot et atzmo, shello zacha haav befidyono. met leachar sheloshim yom — en habben chayyayv lifdot atzmo, shehare zacha haav befidyono.
Vechen mi shello shahata achare balah shelosha chodashim vechulei.
Bechor lannachala hu dela have, ha kefashut shakel. veammay? lezil legabbay hay velidchayeh, ulegabbay hay velidchayeh!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: lo nitzrecha ella labba acharav, vehachi kaamar: bechor lakkohen, vehabba acharav en bechor lannachala.
Velichtevu hareshaa lahadade! vechi tema: matnitin shello behareshaa — ha mokminan la kamman divharshaa!
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yannay, deamar rabbi yannay: hukkeru ulevassof nitarvu — kotvin hareshaa ze laze,
Lo hukkeru uvesof nitarvu — en kotvin hareshaa ze laze.

Mishna e zehu bechor lannachala velakkohen? hammappelet shappir male mayim, male dam, mele geninin, hammappelet kemin dagim vachagavim shekatzim uremasim, vehammappelet leyom arbaim — habba acharehem bechor lannachala ulechohen.
Yotze dofen, vehabba acharav — shenehen enan bechor, lo lannachala velo lakkohen. rabbi shimon omer: harishon lannachala, vehashsheni lechamesh selaim.
Gemara rishon lannachala lo — "veyaldu lo" baenan, lechamesh selaim name la — "patar rechem" baenan.
Sheni lannachala lo — "reshit ono" baenan, lechamesh selaim name la — kasavar: bechor ledavar echad la have bechor.
Rabbi shimon omer: harishon lannachala, vehashsheni lechamesh selaim. rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: "teled" lerabbot yotze dofen.
Vehashsheni lechamesh selaim, kasavar: bechor ledavar echad have bechor.

a: Mishna mi shello bikkera ishto veyalda shene zecharim — noten chamesh selaim lechohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom — haav patur.
Met haav vehabbanim kayyaymim, rabbi meir omer: im natnu ad shello chalku — natanu, veim lav — peturin. rabbi yehuda omer: nitchayyeyvu nechasim. zachar unekeva — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Gemara demit haav emat? illema demit leachar sheloshim yom — beha amar rabbi meir ki chalku peturin? veha ishtabadu lehu (lenichse) [nichse]!

Ella, demit betoch sheloshim yom, may shena ki chalku — deazel legabbe hay umedache leh, deazel legabbe hay umedache leh; ki lo chalku name — lezil legabbe hay velidachayeh, velezil legabbe hay velidachayeh!

Amar rabbi yirmeya: zot omeret, shene yosef ben shimon shehayu beir achat, velakchu sade beshuttafut — baal chov gove otah mehem, deamar leh: i bedidach massekna — menata didach ka shakelna, vei bechavrach massekna — menata dechavrach ka shakelna.

Amar rava: mikkede nichse devar inish innun arvin beh, mi ikka midde dildideh la matze tava leh, ulearev matze tava leh? vehatnan: hammalve et chavero al yede arev — lo yippara min hearev, vekayyma lan delo yitba min hearev techilla!
Ella amar rava: leolam shemmet leachar sheloshim yom, vei deikka nichse tuva — hachi name deshakel, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon delekka ella chamesh selaim.
Udechulle alma it lehu derav assi, deamar rav assi: haachin shechalku — mechetza yorshin umechetza lakochot, udechulle alma milve hakketuva battora
b: Lav kichtuva bishtar damya, udechulle alma it lehu derav pappa, deamar rav pappa: milva al pe gove min hayyorshin veeno gove min hallakochot.
Vehacha bechamesh velo bachatzi chamesh kamippalgi, derabbi meir savar: chamesh velo chatzi chamesh, verabbi yehuda savar: chamesh vaafillu chatzi chamesh.

I hachi, rabbi yehuda omer nitchayyeyvu nechasim, nitchayyev gavra mibbee leh! veod, tanya: rabbi yehuda omer: haachin shechalku, im yesh asara zuz laze vaasara zuz laze — chayyayvin, veim lav — peturin.
May asara zuz laze vaasara zuz laze? illema ben dirushsha ben delakochot, vechamesh vaafillu chatzi chamesh — i hachi, may irya asara? afillu betzir measara name!
Ella peshita, asara zuz dirushsha laze, vaasara zuz dirushsha laze, alma: chamesh velo chatzi chamesh sevira leh!
Ella, dechulle alma chamesh velo chatzi chamesh, vehacha bidrav assi verav pappa kamippalgi.
Veikka dematne leh assefa, nitchayyeyvu hannechasim, demit haav emat? illema demit leachar sheloshim, mikkelal derabbi meir savar ki chalku peturin? ha ishtabadu lehu nichse!
Ella betoch sheloshim, ki chalku, ammay mechayyev rabbi yehuda? lezil legabbe hay lidachayeh, vegabbe hay velidchayeh!

Amar rabbi yirmeya: zot omeret, shene yosef ben shimon shehayu beir achat, velakach echad mehem sade mechavero — baal chov gove mimmennu, daamar leh: i bedidach massekna — menata didach ka shakelna, vei bechavrach massekna — mishtabeda li mikkamme didach.
Amar rava: mikkede nichsohi devar inish innun arvin beh, vechulla kelishshana kamma.

Mishna shete nashim shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim — noten asara selaim lakkohen. met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom, im lechohen echad natan — yachazir lo chamesh selaim, veim lishne kohanim natan — eno yachol lehotzi miyyadam.
Zachar unekeva, o shene zecharim unekeva — noten chamesh selaim lakkohen; shete nekevot vezachar, o shene zecharim ushete nekevot — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera, veyaldu shene zecharim — noten chamesh selaim lakkohen, met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom — haav patur.
Met haav vehabbanim kayyaymim, rabbi meir omer: im natnu ad shello chalku natnu, veim lav peturin. rabbi yehuda omer: nitchayyeyvu nechasim, zachar unekeva en lakkohen kelum.

Shete nashim shel shene anashim shello bikkeru, veyaldu shene zecharim — ze noten chamesh selaim lakkohen veze noten chamesh selaim. met echad mehem betoch sheloshim — im lakkohen echad natanu, yachazir lahem chamesh selaim. im lishne kohanim natanu — enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadam.
Zachar unekeva — haavot peturin, vehabben chayyayv lifdot et atzmo; shete nekevot vezachar, o shete nekevot ushene zecharim — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera, shel shene anashim, veyaldu shene zecharim — ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamesh selaim lakkohen; zachar unekeva — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Gemara may shena shene kohanim, deazel legabbe hay umedache leh, veazel legabbe hay umedache leh?
Kohen echad name lezil legabbe hay velidachayeh, velezil legabbe hay velidachayeh! amar shemuel:

a: Beva behareshaa.
Vehaamri nehardae: la katvinan adrachta ammittalteli! hane mille hecha dechafreh, aval hecha dela kafreh — katvinan.
Zachar unekeva — en kan lakkohen kelum. tana rav huna: shene zecharim unekeva — en kan lakkohen kelum.
Vetanna didan, kevan devishne anashim hu demashkachat la, beish echad ushete nashim la mashkachat la — la mittene leh.

Mishna met habben betoch sheloshim yom, af al pi shennatan lakkohen — yachzir. leachar sheloshim yom, af al pi shello natan — yitten. met beyom sheloshim — keyom shellefanav. rabbi akiva omer: im natan — lo yittol, veim lo natan — lo yitten.
Gemara may tamayyhu derabbanan? gamri "chodesh" "chodesh" mimmidbar, ma hatam "vamala" af hacha name vamala.
Verabbi akiva mesappeka leh, middeitzterich lemichtav "vamala" gabbe arachin, vela gamri mimmidbar — havu lehu shene ketuvim habbaim keechad,
Vechol shene ketuvim habbaim keechad — en melammedin.
O dilma: ki en melammedin — lealma, aval legufayyhu — melammedin, umishshum hachi mesappeka leh.
Amar rav ashe: hakkol modim leinyan avelut, yom sheloshim keyom shellefanav. veamar shemuel: halacha kedivre hammekel beevel.

Mishna met haav betoch sheloshim — bechezkat shello nifda, ad sheyyavi reaya shennifda; leachar sheloshim yom — bechezkat shennifda, ad sheyyomru lo shello nifda. hu lifdot uveno lifdot — hu kodem livno; rabbi yehuda omer: beno kodmo, shemmitzvato al aviv umitzvat beno alav.

Gemara ittemar: happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom, rav amar: beno paduy, ushemuel amar: en beno paduy. dechulle alma "meachshav" — en beno paduy, leachar sheloshim yom veitanhu lemaot — vadday beno paduy.
Ki peligi leachar sheloshim yom, venitakkelu hammaot, rav amar: beno paduy, midde dehave akkiddushe ishsha, hatam lav af al gav denitakkelu hammaot — havu kiddushe,
b: Hacha name la shena.

Ushemuel amar lach: hatam — beyado lekaddeshah meachshav, hacha — en beyado lifdoto meachshav. veaf al gav dekayyma lan, dechol hecha difligi rav ushemuel — hilcheta kerav beissure vechishmuel bedine, hacha hilcheta kevavteh dishmuel.
Tenan: met betoch sheloshim yom, af al pi shennatan lakkohen — yachzir lo chamesh selaim. tama demet, ha lo met — beno paduy! hacha bemay askinan? deitanhu lemaot.
Ta shema: bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyomru lo shennifda! hatam name deitanhu lemaot beenayyhu.

Tane tanna kammeh derav yehuda: happode et beno betoch sheloshim yom — beno paduy. amar leh: shemuel amar en beno paduy, veat amrat beno paduy?! veaf al gav dekayyma lan kerav beissure vechishmuel bedine, hacha hilcheta kevateh dishmuel.
Hu lifdot uveno lifdot — hu kodem livno vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hu lifdot uveno lifdot — hu kodem livno. rabbi yehuda omer: beno kodmo, shemmitzvato al aviv, umitzvat beno alav.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hakkol modim hecha delekka ella chamesh selaim — hu kodem livno, may tama? demitzva dideh adif. ki peligi hecha deikka chamesh meshuebadot vechamesh bene chorin.
Rabbi yehuda savar: milva hakketuva battora — kichtuva bishtar damya, vedideh azel vetaref mimmeshabedi, uvehane chamesh bene chorin — parek leh livreh.
Verabbanan savri: milva hakketuva battora — lav kichtuva bishtar damya, hilkach mitzva dideh adif.
Mishna chamesh selaim shel ben — bemane tzori.
Sheloshim shel eved, chamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte, umea shel motzi shem ra — kullam beshekel hakkodesh, bemane tzori. vechullan nifdin bechesef uveshave kesef, chutz mishshekalim.
Gemara mane tzori. amar rabbi assi: mane shel tzor. rabbi amme amar: dinara (arva) [arvaya]. rabbi chanina omer: istera surseya demizdabbena temanya bedinara, chamesh minnayyhu lefidyon habben.

a: Rabbi yochanan omer: dinara haderiyyayna tiryayna sheyayfa dimzabbena beesrim vechamsha zuze, dal minnayyhu shetuta vehanach lefidyon habben. hane esrin vechad neche danka have!

Ella, dal shetuta vezuza, vehanach lefidyon habben. akkatti esrin neche danka have! ella, dal zuza ushetuta, vehanach lefidyon habben, dehave lehu esrin matkale bematkale dinara, deinnun esrin utemanya zuze ufalge ufalga danka.
Amar rava: silim deorayyta telata vetilta have, dichtiv: "esrim gera hashshekel", umetargeminan: "esrin main", vetanya: shesh maa kesef dinar.
Metivi: vahalo sela shel kodesh arbaim ushemone punedyonin.
Punedyon ze ma tivo? kilbon lapperotrot!
Batar deosifu illavayyhu, detanya: "esrim gera hashshekel" — lamadnu lashshekel shehu esrim gera, uminnayin sheim ratza lehosif yosif? talmud lomar: "yihye", yachol yifchot? talmud lomar: "hu".

Rav ashe shaddar leh shivsar zuze lerav acha bereh deravina befidyon habben, shelach leh: lishaddar li mar tilta yattirta deikka illavayyhu. shelach leh: leshaddar li mar telata acharina deosifu illavayyhu!

Amar rabbi chanina: kol kesef haamur battora setam — sela, dinviim — litrin, dichtuvin — kinterin, chutz min kaspo shel efron, sheaf al pi shekkatuv battora setam — kintarin, dichtiv "arba meot shekel kesef over lassocher", veikka ducheta deka karu lekintara "tikla".

Amar rabbi oshaya: bikkeshu lignoz kol kesef vezahav shebbaolam mippene kaspah uzehavah shel yerushalayim, ad shemmatzu lo mikra min hattora shehu muttar, shenneemar: "uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha".

Virushalayim havya rubba dealma? ella amar abbaye: bikkeshu lignoz dinara haderiyyayna tiryayna sheyayfa, mippene tivah shel yerushalayim, ad shemmatzu lah mikra min hattora shehu muttar, shenneemar: "uvau vah paritzim vechilleluha".
b: Rav yehuda amar rav assi: kol "kesef" haamur battora setam — kesef tzori, veshel divrehem — kesef medina.
Uchelala hu? vahare taana, dichtiv: "ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor",
Utenan: shevuat haddayyaynin — hattaana shete chesef!
Shane hatam, dichtiv: "kesef o chelim", ma kelim shenayim — af kesef shenayim, uma kesef davar chashuv — af kelim davar chashuv.
Vahare maaser, dichtiv: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", utenan: happoret sela bimot maaser sheni! "kesef" "kesef" ribba.
Vahare hekdesh, dichtiv "venatan hakkesef vekam lo", veamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta mechullal! hekdesh name yalef "kodesh" "kodesh" mimmaaser.
Vahare kiddushe ishsha, dichtiv: "veyatza chinnam en kasef", utenan: bet shammay omrim: bedinar uveshave dinar, uvet hillel omrim: bifruta uveshave peruta, lema rav assi deamar kevet shammay?
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: kol kesef katzuv haamur battora — kesef tzori, veshel divrehem — kesef medina.
May kamashma lan? tenena: chamesh selaim shel ben vechulei!
Veshel divrehem kesef medina itztericha leh, ditnan: hattokea lachavero noten lo sela, vela tema sela arba zuze, ella palga dezuza, dekaru inashe "sela" palga dezuza.
Chanan bisha teka leh lehahu gavra, ata lekammeh derav huna, amar leh: hav leh palga dezuza. hava ikka

a: Zuza macha bahadeh dela nafek, teka leh acharina veyahaveh nihaleh.
Sheloshim shel eved, chamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte vechulei. ha tu lema li? ha tena leh resha!
Ones umotzi shem ra itzterich, salka datach amena: kevan dela ketiv behu "shekalim", ema zuze bealma, ka mashma lan demelaf ka yalfi mehadade.
Chutz min hashshekalim. tana: chutz min hashshekalim, umaaser, vehareayon.
Shekalim — ditnan: metzarfin shekalim ledarbonot, mippene massooy hadderech.
Maaser — dichtiv: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", vehareayon — tane rav yosef: shello yavi siga laazara.

Mishna en podin lo baavadim, velo bishtarot, velo bekarkaot, velo behekdeshot. katav lechohen shehu chayyayv litten chamishsha selaim — chayyayv litten lo, uveno eno paduy. lefichach, im ratza hakkohen litten lo bemattana — rashshay.
Hammafrish pidyon beno, veavad — chayyayv beachrayuto, shenneemar: "yihye lach" ufado tifde".
Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi, detanya: rabbi omer: bakkol podin bechor adam, chutz min hashshetarot. may tama derabbi?
Daresh ribbuye umiute, "ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde" — ribba, "beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim" — miet, "tifde" — ribba.
Ribba umiet veribba, ribba hakkol. may rabbi? rabbi kol mille, umay mayet? mayet shetarot.
Verabbanan darshi kelal uferat: "vfduyav mibben chodesh" — kalal, "beerkecha kesef chameshet shekalim" — parat, (pado) "tifde" — chazar vechalal.

Kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash — davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon. yatzu karkaot — sheen mittaltelin, yatzu avadim — shehukkeshu lekarkaot, yatzu shetarot — sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon.
Amar leh ravina lemarimar: verabbi, ribbuye umiute daresh? veha rabbi kelale uferate daresh bemartzea!

Detanya: "martzea" — en li ella martzea, minnayin lerabbot hassol vehassira vehammachat vehammakdeach vehammachtev? talmud lomar "velakachta" — lerabbot kol davar shennilkach bayyad, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. rabbi omer: "martzea" — ma martzea meyuchad shel mattechet, af kol shel mattechet.
Veamrinan: bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi daresh kelale uferate, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda daresh ribbuye umiute.
In bealma rabbi kelale uferate daresh, vehacha kidtana deve rabbi yishmael.
Detana deve rabbi yishmael: "bemayim" "bammayim" shete feamim, en ze kelal uferat, ella ribba umiet.
Verabbanan amri: kidamrinan bemareva, kol makom sheatta motze shete chelalot hassemuchim ze laze — hattel perat benehem, vedunem bichlal uferat.
Velo behekdeshot. peshita, lav dideh ninhu! ema:
b: Velo hekdeshot bechol ellu.
Katav lechohen shehu chayyayv lo chamishsha selaim chayyayv litten lo kulei. amar ulla: devar tora beno paduy, may tama en beno paduy? gezera shemma yomru podin bishtar.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: beno paduy lichsheyyitten. amar leh rav nachman: zo divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda (sateymetaa) [setimtaa], veamri la: zo divre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon setimtaa, aval chachamim omrim: en beno paduy. vehilcheta: en beno paduy.
Lefichach im ratza hakkohen litten lo bemattana — rashshay. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: netano laasara kohanim bevat achat — yatza, beze achar ze — yatza, netalo vehechziro lo — yatza.
Vechach haya minhago shel rabbi tarfon, shehaya notel umachzir. uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar amru: kiyyem ze halacha zo. halacha zo vetu la? ella, kiyyem ze af halacha zo.
Rabbi chanina hava regil (veshakel) [deshakel] umahdar, chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava ka azel veate kammeh, amar leh: la gemart vihevt — middaam bish, hilkach en beno paduy.
Hammafrish pidyon beno veavad — chayyayv beachrayuto. menalan? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: atya "erech" "erech" mearachin.
Rav dimi amar rabbi yonatan: "vechol bechor banecha tifde velo yerau fanay rekam", veyalef "rekam" "rekam" meolat reiyyay, ma olat reiyyay chayyayv beachrayuto, af pidyon habben chayyayv beachrayuto.
Matkef la rav pappa: kera likra? ella amar rav pappa: ha kidkatane tama — "yihye lach... ach pado tifde".
Vechi ittemar deresh lakish — aresha ittemar: met leachar sheloshim yom, af al pi shello natan — yitten. mena lan? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: atya "erech" "erech" mearachin.
Rav dimi amar rabbi yonatan: "vechol bechor banecha tifde velo yerau fanay rekam", ma lehallan yorshin chayyayvin, af kan yorshin chayyayvin.
Mishna habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haav, veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem, veeno notel bashshevach, velo berauy kivmuchezak.
